items.title: Paris in Love
items.overview: Along with her fiancé, family and friends, Paris Hilton plans the most “sliving” wedding of all time while also working, relaxing and prepping for her journey as a potential mom.
items.description: Along with her fiancé, family and friends, Paris Hilton plans the most “sliving” wedding of all time while also working, relaxing and prepping for her journey as a potential mom.

episodes.title: The Unengaged Bride
episodes.overview: Paris Hilton begins her journey to the altar with fiancé Carter Reum, but her family and friends wonder why she seems unable to commit to the simplest of wedding details.

episodes.title: A Mother of a Bride
episodes.overview: Paris gets caught between her fiancé and her mother when Carter and Kathy engage in a tug-of-war over wedding plans. Barron Hilton ÌI comes to his sister's rescue when she needs help with issues from her past.

episodes.title: You Can Go Home Again
episodes.overview: Paris balances the search for a wedding venue with her desire to record new music. Kathy Hilton wanting to stick with Hilton family traditions leads to unexpected and emotional revelations.

episodes.title: Live From Las Vegas
episodes.overview: Paris lights up Las Vegas at the grand opening of a casino named after her great-grandfather. Carter's desire to have children soon after the marriage leads Paris to question how her life will change.

episodes.title: The Michigan Life
episodes.overview: Paris takes a trip to Carter's hometown in Michigan to DJ a family member's wedding, but the striking difference between the Hilton and Reum families leads Paris to question Carter's plans for their future.

episodes.title: The Fashion and the Furious
episodes.overview: Paris and the family head to New York for the couple's engagement party, but the setting turns less celebratory as a struggle between Kathy and Carter becomes public. Paris attempts to hide behind her commitments tied to New York Fashion Week.

episodes.title: Serendipity and Secrets
episodes.overview: Facing the mounting requirements of a bride-to-be, Paris has a breakdown — much to the dismay and concern of her mother and sister, Nicky.

episodes.title: Past Imperfect
episodes.overview: Back in Los Angeles, Paris seeks help with the support of her mother and confronts past issues she has avoided.

episodes.title: Too Close for Carter
episodes.overview: Paris and Carter are surprised when Kathy rents a house down the beach from theirs. Kathy makes an unexpected admission to Paris, leading Paris to finally take control of the wedding.

episodes.title: Bachelor Party Bacchanal
episodes.overview: Paris and Carter celebrate a joint bachelor and bachelorette party in Las Vegas with family and friends. The indulgent atmosphere sends the bride-to-be into an emotional spiral.

episodes.title: Ms. Hilton Goes to Washington
episodes.overview: Kathy joins Paris as she heads to Washington, D.C., on behalf of a reform school bill Paris created to prevent teens from experiencing what she went through.

episodes.title: I Do, Don't I? (1)
episodes.overview: The final week of the wedding is filled with unexpected revelations, leading to the long-awaited moment and the beautiful bride.

episodes.title: I Do, Don't I? (2)
episodes.overview: The final week of the wedding is filled with unexpected revelations, leading to the long-awaited moment and the beautiful bride.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In Season 2, fans will get an intimate look at pop-culture icon Paris Hilton's journey into motherhood - from behind the scenes of her secret surrogacy plans to her juggling work and family life as a new mom.

episodes.title: Big Little Secret
episodes.overview: Paris and Carter keep their surrogate’s pregnancy a secret from their families and the world, while Paris continues to work around the clock building her media empire.

episodes.title: Phoenix Is Rising
episodes.overview: After welcoming their son, Paris and Carter worry about how their family will react to being kept in the dark.

episodes.title: Boy Meets World
episodes.overview: Paris braces for her family’s reaction to baby Phoenix. Paris’ painful past threatens to send more shockwaves through her life.

episodes.title: Truth and Consequences
episodes.overview: Publicity for Paris’ memoir reveals bombshells hidden from the family for decades, causing rifts in her relationships with both Kathy and Nicky.

episodes.title: Paris Tells All
episodes.overview: While on the publicity tour for her memoir, Paris shares shocking past traumas and Kathy feels blindsided.

episodes.title: Capital Hilton
episodes.overview: When Paris returns to Washington, D.C. to introduce her anti-child abuse bill, Nicky provides a clue to Kathy’s emotional distance. Paris revives her singing career.

episodes.title: The Show Must Go On?
episodes.overview: Excruciating pain threatens to derail Paris’ first live concert. Paris misses a Phoenix milestone and later makes a big confession to her therapist about motherhood.

episodes.title: Seeking the Simple Life
episodes.overview: Paris takes center stage at the Fonda Theatre in Los Angeles for her first concert. Back home, Paris refocuses her priorities on family.

items.title: Mousetrap
items.overview: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."
items.description: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

seasons.name: Limited Series
seasons.overview: Je Moon-jae, a reclusive novelist who becomes desperate after a mysterious figure known as "The Rat" steals his identity and financial assets. To reclaim his life, he forms an unlikely alliance with Noja, a loan shark-turned-private investigator, leading them into a tense manhunt to uncover the truth behind the identity theft and the dark conspiracy hidden beneath it.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: While hiding from society, a reclusive genius novelist Je Moon-jae falls victim to identity theft — only to be confronted by his doppelganger.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Noja uncovers the world of identity laundering after Moon-jae escapes his grip. Meanwhile, Detective Park Sun-yong pieces together the link between them.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Suspicious but intrigued, Noja takes Moon-jae on as both a client and a hostage. Their uneasy alliance leads them to setting up a carefully planned trap.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Moon-jae suspects The Rat may be a figure from his past. Following his newly recovered memory, he and Noja head to the island where the man once stayed.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: A shocking tie surfaces between Noja and The Rat, while Sun-yong closes in on crucial evidence. Later, The Rat appears publicly, cornering Moon-jae.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Moon-jae reaches out to his longtime editor, hoping she can vouch for him. Lost in confusion, a text from Noja becomes his only lifeline.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: After barely escaping, Moon-jae joins a frantic race for someone who can reveal his identity. Later, Sun-yong discovers a shocking truth about his past.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Moon-jae sinks deeper into trouble. Sun-yong heads to a nursing home for answers — only to find his witness gone. Later, Noja's past buries him alive.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Moon-jae evades police to meet The Rat where it all began. Noja leaves him with heartfelt advice as Sun-yong continues to pursue a key witness.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Moon-jae stands at the center of a trap a lifetime in the making. Every lie and stolen identity surfaces as he questions: Is he the predator or the prey?

items.title: Reacher
items.overview: Jack Reacher, a veteran military police investigator, has just recently entered civilian life. Reacher is a drifter, carrying no phone and the barest of essentials as he travels the country and explores the nation he once served.
items.description: Jack Reacher, a veteran military police investigator, has just recently entered civilian life. Reacher is a drifter, carrying no phone and the barest of essentials as he travels the country and explores the nation he once served.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Based on "Killing Floor," when retired Military Police Officer Jack Reacher is arrested for a murder he did not commit, he finds himself in the middle of a deadly conspiracy full of dirty cops, shady businessmen and scheming politicians. With nothing but his wits, he must figure out what is happening in Margrave, Georgia.

episodes.title: Welcome to Margrave
episodes.overview: Reacher is wrongly accused of murder while visiting the small town of Margrave, GA.

episodes.title: First Dance
episodes.overview: When more victims are discovered, Reacher attempts to get answers but is set up. Roscoe receives a threatening message.

episodes.title: Spoonful
episodes.overview: Reacher and Finlay’s investigation into the missing Spivey leads them into a confrontation with Kliner Sr. Roscoe learns unsettling news about Reacher.

episodes.title: In a Tree
episodes.overview: As the danger increases, Reacher and Roscoe grow closer and they make plans to meet with their contact from Homeland Security.

episodes.title: No Apologies
episodes.overview: As the mystery deepens, Reacher teams up with an old colleague and Finlay makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Papier
episodes.overview: As the town is rocked by another murder, Reacher heads to New York and learns the truth about the illegal business in Margrave while Roscoe faces danger in the woods.

episodes.title: Reacher Said Nothing
episodes.overview: Reacher springs a trap and then gets trapped himself.

episodes.title: Pie
episodes.overview: Reacher leads a rescue mission at the warehouse that ends in a showdown.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Based on "Bad Luck and Trouble," when members of Reacher's old military unit start turning up dead, Reacher has just one thing on his mind—revenge.

episodes.title: ATM
episodes.overview: Reacher and Neagley investigate the murder of a member of 110th, a group of Special investigators assembled by Reacher, only to realize the whole unit may be at risk.

episodes.title: What Happens in Atlantic City
episodes.overview: The investigation into Franz's murder takes Reacher and the surviving members of his former Army unit to Atlantic City where the mystery deepens, danger awaits, and an old flame is rekindled.

episodes.title: Picture Says a Thousand Words
episodes.overview: After more of his friends fall victim, Reacher forges an uneasy alliance with a dogged detective, and their only clue in the case leads the 110th to a troubling discovery.

episodes.title: A Night at the Symphony
episodes.overview: Reacher and his team head to Boston to track down a political aide with insider knowledge of a top secret military-defense contract that may be the reason behind their friends' deaths.

episodes.title: Burial
episodes.overview: Neagley and Dixon discover shocking information about an old friend in Denver while Reacher and O'Donnell learn more about the nefarious and mysterious A.M..

episodes.title: New York's Finest
episodes.overview: As the mystery continues to unfold, Reacher and his team set a trap to even the score.

episodes.title: The Man Goes Through
episodes.overview: As the team close in on Langston, two members of the 110th face danger, compelling Reacher to devise a dangerous plan to rescue them.

episodes.title: Fly Boy
episodes.overview: Reacher and Neagley make a final desperate attempt to save O’Donnell and Dixon, stop A.M. and avenge their friends’ murder.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Based on "Persuader," Reacher hurtles into the dark heart of a vast criminal enterprise when trying to rescue an undercover DEA informant whose time is running out. There he finds a world of secrecy and violence—and confronts some unfinished business from his own past.

episodes.title: Persuader
episodes.overview: Reacher's attempt to thwart a kidnapping brings him into contact with mysterious businessman Zachary Beck.

episodes.title: Truckin'
episodes.overview: Tasked with transporting cargo for his new employer Zachary Beck, Reacher must juggle the involvement of the DEA and a nosy new associate.

episodes.title: Number 2 with a Bullet
episodes.overview: As a rising body count threatens his undercover position, Reacher makes a dangerous play to secure Beck's trust.

episodes.title: Dominique
episodes.overview: Reacher reunites with Duffy and Villanueva and finally shares the painful details of his history with Xavier Quinn.

episodes.title: Smackdown
episodes.overview: When a DEA tragedy puts the entire mission at risk, Reacher, Duffy, and Villanueva improvise a drastic plan to save their cover.

episodes.title: Smoke on the Water
episodes.overview: Reacher is torn between his desire to kill Quinn and his promise to Duffy to save Teresa.

episodes.title: L.A. Story
episodes.overview: After Reacher and Duffy travel to Los Angeles to arrange a deal, Neagley arrives in Maine to help Reacher get answers.

episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.overview: Reacher finally faces off with both Paulie and Quinn.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Based on "Gone Tomorrow," when a chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a subway goes horribly wrong, Jack Reacher is drawn into a complex and deadly game that pits him against ruthless foes from the highest echelons of power.

episodes.title: City of Brotherly Love
episodes.overview: A chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a Philadelphia subway car draws Jack Reacher into a deadly mystery involving a missing flash drive that contains secrets worth killing for.

episodes.title: Cage Fight
episodes.overview: Tamara finds herself caught up in the mystery whether she likes it or not as she, Reacher, and Jacob face off against shady government agents and a mysterious squad of professional soldiers all looking for the same missing flash drive.

episodes.title: One Small Step
episodes.overview: Reacher learns that things are more complex than they seem as he and Lila draw closer. Meanwhile, Tamara, Jacob, and Plum find an important clue after another attack from one of their mysterious adversaries sends them back to Philadelphia.

episodes.title: Karambits and Pieces
episodes.overview: Reacher interrogates Sampson, Tamara breaks into a government facility, Jacob receives some crushing news and the team learns a piece of information that changes everything.

episodes.title: Bridge
episodes.overview: After a misunderstanding, Reacher becomes Philadelphia's Most Wanted. Meanwhile, old enemies catch up with him and new ones emerge. Jacob, Tamara and Plum end up in a firefight, giving Jacob his first real shot at avenging his sister's death.

episodes.title: Plum Out of Luck
episodes.overview: Fleeing the police, Reacher and Tamara head out-of-town to find the mysterious Ahlquist only to run into more trouble. Meanwhile, Jacob and Plum deal with their own problems back in Philadelphia.

episodes.title: Vote for Sampson
episodes.overview: Reacher and Tamara finally get the answers they've been looking for. Meanwhile, Jacob learns that their problems are just beginning when Plum's sources come through with some timely information.

episodes.title: Cut
episodes.overview: Reacher, Tamara and Jacob take the fight to the enemy as the full extent of their plot is revealed. Reacher faces off with those responsible for Anna's death while Jacob faces a moment of truth and Plum gets his shot at redemption.

items.title: Resort
items.overview: A debt-ridden room service boy rises to challenge a ruthless kitchen at a luxurious beachside haven.
items.description: A debt-ridden room service boy rises to challenge a ruthless kitchen at a luxurious beachside haven.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A 12th-fail room service boy rises to challenge a ruthless kitchen at a luxurious beachside haven.

episodes.title: Hell's Kitchen
episodes.overview: Vetri is a village boy burdened by his family responsibilities. His journey begins at RR Resort, where he comes face-to-face with Nedumaran, the resort kitchen's dictator.

episodes.title: Unwitting Actions
episodes.overview: Pandi guides Vetri through the resort to familiarise him with how things work there. Later, Aishu is harshly punished by Nedumaran because of Vetri's careless mistake.

episodes.title: The Lid is Lifted
episodes.overview: Vetri gets an opportunity to earn a living with his cooking. He comes across Nedumaran's signature soup. Meanwhile, an influencer couple raises a ruckus in the resort.

episodes.title: Doomed
episodes.overview: Nedumaran is enraged when Rajan speaks about cost-cutting. Vetri further aggravates his mood by selling his soup recipe from a street cart. Will Vetri survive Nedumaran's wrath?

episodes.title: Be Irreplaceable
episodes.overview: Nedumaran fumes as an inexperienced Vetri cracks his signature dish recipe. His plea to join the kitchen team is denied. Joji enjoys Vetri's Rasam rice. A prank on Aishu backfires.

episodes.title: Behind the Mask
episodes.overview: Joji tells Vetri that his Rasam rice reminded him of his college love. Aishu tries to sabotage Vetri's service by changing the dishes. Vetri finds out about Aishu's secret life.

episodes.title: Wave of Nostalgia
episodes.overview: Vetri plays cupid for Joji. Vetri's effort to make peace with Aishu fails. Aishu panics when she learns that Vetri is aware of her masked secret. Riya tries to patch up with Aishu.

episodes.title: Ghost from the Past
episodes.overview: Vetri helps Aishu and Veni with his cooking skills. Furious at first, Nedumaran is surprised when he tastes Vetri's dish. Later, he is shocked to learn who Vetri's father is.

episodes.title: Frozen in Fear
episodes.overview: Foreign guests like Vetri's dish, and he gets considered for the kitchen team. However, this opportunity rattles others in the kitchen.

episodes.title: Opportunity or Adversity?
episodes.overview: Nedumaran's decision about Vetri's entry into the kitchen shocks everyone. Will Vetri be up for the challenge?

episodes.title: Gearing Up
episodes.overview: Riya checks into the resort to comfort herself. Meanwhile, among gifts and sleeplessness, Vetri eagerly anticipates his big day in the kitchen.

episodes.title: Lifeblood of the Kitchen
episodes.overview: All prepared, Vetri delegates the day's menu to the kitchen staff. However, the new chef faces many struggles, the worst being the interruption of gas supply.

episodes.title: Sense of Schadenfreude
episodes.overview: Vetri rises to the challenge by using firewood stove and wins praises for the lunch menu. Seeing the kitchen's condition, Nedumaran throws Vetri out and is happy about his failure.

episodes.title: Fresh Ally
episodes.overview: Vetri's special Biryani request from the guests is rejected. Aishu stands up for Vetri when Vicky mocks him. She makes an appeal when Vetri and Pandi visit the bar where she sings.

episodes.title: Comeuppance
episodes.overview: The room service team gets targeted by the kitchen team after Vetri's failure. While Nedumaran announces Aishu as the new Sous Chef, he punishes Vicky for his reckless behaviour.

episodes.title: Covetous Desire
episodes.overview: Veni confronts Aishu for going against Vicky. Nedumaran feigns joy when Ragupathi informs him about handing over the resort to Riya. Deepak's announcement at the party shocks Riya.

episodes.title: The Good Girl Syndrome
episodes.overview: Ragupathi watches Riya being tortured by Deepak. Vetri and Aishu cook a special dish for Joji's date with his lady love. Aishu tries to tell her dad about her passion for singing.

episodes.title: Emotional Armour
episodes.overview: Ragupathi assures Riya of his support. Veni feels bad for Vicky who is frustrated with his room service job. Joji and Padma's date is ruined by Padma's daughter.

episodes.title: Seething Anger
episodes.overview: Nedumaran is angry as Ragupathi's request was actually Vetri's recipe. Joji bids adieu to Padma with a heavy heart. Vetri attends Nedumaran's call for Aishu by mistake.

episodes.title: Face from the Past
episodes.overview: Riya decides to continue staying at the resort. Rajan sorts an issue when John tries to blow it up. Nedumaran pretends not to recall Chidambaram when an old friend asks about him.

episodes.title: Close Confidante
episodes.overview: Aishu spots Veni and Vicky having an argument and feels betrayed. Though Rajan warns Riya, she tries to talk to Nedumaran about the food expenditure.

episodes.title: Secret Kitchen
episodes.overview: Vetri and Pandi hunt for a place and an investor to start their new business. Aishu tries talking to Vicky about Veni, which ends in disaster.

episodes.title: Drifting Apart
episodes.overview: Uthaman intervenes when Vetri and Vicky get into an intense argument. At Siva's birthday party, Veni sees Srinidhi and Vicky together, and she gets upset and drunk.

episodes.title: Where is Chika?
episodes.overview: Riya talks to Rajan about the resort's major problem: food. Vetri's dish from his secret kitchen gets mistakenly delivered to the wrong guest. Will Vetri get caught?

episodes.title: Lovelorn Veni
episodes.overview: Nedumaran ruins Riya's attempt to change things in the resort. Back in the kitchen team, Vicky breaks up with Veni. Vetri and Aishu save Veni when she tries to end her life.

episodes.title: Delving into the Past
episodes.overview: Leo's words remind Ragupathi of Chika and he decides to locate him. Nedumaran humiliates Aishu after seeing her with Vetri. Aishu learns about Vetri’s father and his family's past.

episodes.title: The Supercilious Chef
episodes.overview: When Vicky questions Nedumaran for making Aishu the Sous Chef, a cooking challenge is held between them. Ragupathi’s decision to find the truth about Chidambaram upsets Nedumaran.

episodes.title: Resurfacing of Memories
