items.title: Thukra Ke Mera Pyaar
items.overview: Two families clash over societal and caste differences spurring a saga of revenge. All this happens when a love story goes wrong.
items.description: Two families clash over societal and caste differences spurring a saga of revenge. All this happens when a love story goes wrong.

episodes.title: Chauhano Ki Shaan
episodes.overview: Shanvika, the arrogant daughter of the elite Chauhan family. Kuldeep, a poor but brilliant young man. A broken bicycle leads to a meaningful exchange between the two.

episodes.title: Humse Dosti Karoge?
episodes.overview: Nakul and his cronies try to snatch Kuldeep's new bicycle from him, leading to a fight. Shanvika interferes, and she poses a question to Kuldeep.

episodes.title: Aapki Pehchan Hai Kya?
episodes.overview: Kuldeep's disinterest in her proposal makes Shanvika angry. She vows to outscore him academically, setting the stage for competition.

episodes.title: Namak Harami Mat Karna
episodes.overview:
Shanvika misbehaves with Inspector Dushyant Singh when she declares

she'll rank first in her class. Her "hard work" bears fruit, and Kuldeep goes missing. Where did he go?

episodes.title: Ishq Hua Hai!
episodes.overview: Shanvika and Kuldeep's romance blossoms. However, one day, Pushkar and his men bust their blissful moment, leading to tension between the families.

episodes.title: Galti Hamari Nahi Thi
episodes.overview: Shanvika's declaration leads to Kuldeep's family being humiliated in public. They flee for life after Pushkar sets fire to their house, but Simmi's tragic step shatters them.

episodes.title: Saaye Mai Dhoop
episodes.overview: Kuldeep starts driving a rickshaw for a living. Prerna, a passenger preparing for the UPSC exams, inspires him to reflect on his dreams and look forward to a bright future.

episodes.title: Namak Haram
episodes.overview: Family pressures Shanvika into marrying Dushyant reluctantly. Kuldeep focuses on studies but faces devastation after a fateful call.

episodes.title: Tu Hoga Kamyaab
episodes.overview: Shanvika's rejection of Dushyant on their wedding night sparks turmoil. Kuldeep grapples with inner conflicts as Prerna guides him to harness his anger constructively.

episodes.title: Chaman Mein Deedawar
episodes.overview: Kuldeep's life hangs in the balance as he faces his UPSC final interview and his mother's coma. The UPSC results bring a shocking revelation, especially those in Sitaarpur.

episodes.title: Mera Lakshya Kuch Aur Hai
episodes.overview: Kuldeep's political return sparks chaos when he proposes building a bridge in a Chauhan area. Daddu proposes an easy way for him to do it.

episodes.title: Astitwa ki Ladai
episodes.overview: Under Kuldeep's orders, all boating operations are sealed, paving the way for the bridge project. During his and Mala's wedding, tensions escalate with the arrival of the Chauhans.

episodes.title: Bhoot, Bhavishya, Vartaman
episodes.overview: The Chauhans are infuriated seeing Dushyant guarding Kuldeep. Mala speaks to her new husband about their future. The Chauhan's face losses when their businesses are raided.

episodes.title: Woh Badla Lene Hi Aaya Hai
episodes.overview: Dushyant warns Shanvika of Kuldeep's desire for revenge but she refuses to engage. Fed up with Kuldeep's high handed behaviour, the Chauhans hire Gauri to kill him.

episodes.title: Kuch Bachna Nahi Chahiye
episodes.overview: Gauri, on the run from the police, is abducted by unknown men. He urgently contacts Angad to meet the Chauhans at their hideout. Meanwhile, Kuldeep raids the Chauhan's house

episodes.title: Ghar Ka Malik Bhag Chala
episodes.overview: The Chauhan brothers surrender, which creates a sensation. In prison, Manohar wonders about his past actions. Meanwhile, Kuldeep throws a party and invites Dushyant and Shanvika

episodes.title: Ab Apna Rasta Badal Lo
episodes.overview: Dushyant decides to resign, but Kuldeep refuses and makes an offer. Gendalal warns Kuldeep about Daddu, who has a different plan for Chauhan's son in law.

episodes.title: Sab Kuch Khatam Ho Gaya
episodes.overview: Daddu instructs SP Mishra to apprehend Pushkar, but he flees. Shanvika consoles a troubled Dushyant. Kuldeep meets his childhood friend Pintu, who advises him.

episodes.title: Ab Humari Baari
episodes.overview: Kuldeep finally learns why Shanvika lied about their relationship. Tragedy strikes yet again, and Shanvika has no choice but to pick up the pieces of her shattered life.

episodes.title: Naye Dushman ya Naye Dost?
episodes.overview: Shanvika performs her husband Dushyant's last rites as Sitaarpur watches. On her journey home, she is ambushed, forcing her into a gun fight. Who is her new enemy?

episodes.title: Kunwar ki Ummid, Shanvika ki Chaal
episodes.overview: Kuldeep spirals into guilt over Shanvika despite Mala and Daddu's efforts to help him. Tensions rise as a looming threat pushes Shanvika to make a strategic move.

episodes.title: Bas Ek Mulakaat
episodes.overview: Multiple attacks on Shanvika heighten tensions across Sitaarpur. As she prepares herself for the battles ahead, a shocking revelation shakes her trust.

episodes.title: Kuldeep ka Prayashchit
episodes.overview: Angad finds himself trapped in Shanvika's scheme, while Kuldeep's guilt drives him toward a risky move. As political conspiracies deepen, Shanvika finally agrees to meet Kuldeep.

episodes.title: Pyaar ka Nostalgia
episodes.overview: Shanvika confronts Kuldeep, gun in hand, yet her pain overpowers her anger. They exchange their losses, leading Kuldeep to agree to join her dangerous quest for justice.

episodes.title: Pushkar ki Jaan ko Khatra hai
episodes.overview: Chaos erupts as Pushkar faces danger in the hospital, but Shanvika intervenes to rescue him. Angad shoots a corrupt doctor unaware that he is under surveillance.

episodes.title: Raajneeti par Pyaar Bhaari
episodes.overview: Kunwar assures Shanvika of his support but grows furious over Pushkar's disappearance, suspecting Daddu. Shanvika and Kuldeep clash when she admits ordering Dr Vinay's murder.

episodes.title: Shanvika ka Naya Rakshak
episodes.overview: Shanvika is ambushed but saved by a masked shooter, leaving Daddu shaken. Suspicious, Daddu asks Singh to bring Mala home and keep a close watch on Kuldeep.

episodes.title: Transfer yaa Saazish?
episodes.overview: Obsessed with Kuldeep, Mala opposes Daddu's plan to kill him and pledges to ruin Shanvika. Subsequently, Daddu discloses Kuldeep's unexpected transfer order, shocking Kuldeep.

episodes.title: Nani ki Seekh, Pyaar ki Jeet
episodes.overview: Daddu celebrates his political move and plots Shanvika's death after Kuldeep's transfer. A powerful flashback inspires Kuldeep to move in a way that leaves Daddu stunned.

episodes.title: Imaandari ka Sabut
episodes.overview: Saadhu and Kundan commit a crime, triggering a chain reaction that shakes Sitaarpur. Shanvika quietly turns the fallout to her advantage by letting Kunwar take the credit.

episodes.title: Varchasva ki Ladai!
episodes.overview: Poornima's death sparks an all-out war as Daddu Prasad commands the annihilation of Kunwar's family. Amid the turmoil, Shanvika and Pushkar secretly scheme for their rise.

episodes.title: Deewaron Ke Bhi Aakhein Hoti Hain
episodes.overview: Prerna and Pushkar grow closer, unaware of the danger ahead. As panic spreads over the police murders, Daddu uses Angad to trap Shanvika, but Kuldeep foils the plan.

episodes.title: Kaptaan Mara Gaya!
episodes.overview: As Angad is hidden away for safety, Kuldeep manipulates Daddu's suspicions. Daddu then orders Saadhu and Kundan to kill Shanvika or pay with their lives.

episodes.title: 2 Prime Suspects!
episodes.overview: Public outrage over SP Mishra's murder prompts the Chief Minister to transfer the case to the Intelligence Agency. Shockingly, Shanvika and Kuldeep emerge as key suspects.

episodes.title: Gheera!
episodes.overview: Constable Divya's interrogation exposes SP Mishra's corruption. Suspicion grows around Kuldeep as Pradeep disappears, only to resurface under arrest for his covert role.

episodes.title: Baazi Palat Gayi!
episodes.overview: During Intelligence Agency’s probing, Angad reveals how Daddu Prasad planned murders to protect his power. Shanvika emerges as a formidable force in Sitaarpur’s political field.

episodes.title: Alert!
episodes.overview: The Intelligence Agency exposes Daddu Prasad’s political scheme and arrests him amid public outrage. While love and victory bring Kuldeep and Shanvika closer, Pintu is abducted.

episodes.title: Uttaradhikari Mil Gaya!
episodes.overview: As Pintu’s kidnapping haunts Kuldeep, Sitaarpur is sealed, criminals rounded up, and pressure mounts. While Daddu plots his comeback, Mala’s vengeance is finally exposed.

episodes.title: Satta Ka Safar!
episodes.overview: Kuldeep learns Pintu’s murder was meant to break him. He urges Shanvika to get into politics. She asserts control by striking a business deal. Kunwar assures her a minister’s post.

episodes.title: Siyasi Zameen
episodes.overview: Kunwar proposes Shanvika's candidature to the Chief Minister, shifting political equations. Meanwhile, Kuldeep mentors Shanvika, stirring old feelings and Mala's insecurity.

episodes.title: Ticket Mil Gaya
episodes.overview: Shanvika's political rise rattles Daddu and Kunwar. Celebrations begin at the Chauhan Mansion as Shanvika's ticket is announced, while masked men abduct Kuldeep's family.

episodes.title: Maut ka Badla Maut!
episodes.overview: Ranjan's death drives Chatki to seek revenge against Kunwar. Meanwhile, Daddu Prasad returns to politics after securing bail, raising the stakes for all.

episodes.title: Shaam 5:00 Baje
episodes.overview: A coded call helps Kuldeep escape captivity, exposing a conspiracy linked to Ramlal's camp. Shanvika's campaign sweeps the polls, defeating Daddu by a huge margin.

episodes.title: Result!
episodes.overview: Shanvika celebrates her political success, but Kuldeep loses his father, Gendalal, to a brutal murder. Seeking revenge, Kuldeep attacks Daddu and ends up in jail.

episodes.title: Badalte Raste!
episodes.overview: Mala confesses to her father of plotting Kuldeep's father’s murder. After Daddu Prasad’s statement, Kuldeep is reinstated as the DM. Shanvika assumes her new role as a minister.

episodes.title: Samuhik Vivah!
episodes.overview: Bansal runs a human trafficking racket under a mass marriage scheme. Kuldeep learns of Pushkar's release. Returning to Sitaarpur, Pushkar ruthlessly reclaims his control.

episodes.title: Sangathan!
episodes.overview: Kuldeep orders strict action against illegal arms after Pushkar's return. He asks Daddu and Rantej to unite with Bansal and Rathod. The battle for Sitaarpur grows deadly than ever.

episodes.title: Aslaah
episodes.overview: Kuldeep intensifies his crackdown on Pushkar by ordering strict legal action against illegal arms. At Bansal's office, Pushkar reviews the progress of their criminal network.

episodes.title: Pyaar Nahi toh Dosti hi Sahi
episodes.overview: Kuldeep is cleared by the court and is determined to take on the Chauhan family. As Pushkar and Prerna grow closer, Kuldeep and Mala choose to begin their bond as friends.

episodes.title: Tender
episodes.overview: A ₹1,000 crore tender fuels a political power struggle in Sitaarpur. Pushkar's unexpected marriage alters the dynamics amidst secret alliances and concealed conspiracies.

episodes.title: Humein Chinta hai Tumhari
episodes.overview: A cancelled government tender deepens the rift between Shanvika and Kuldeep. Pushkar stirs up a public spectacle, pushing Sitaarpur toward deeper political conflict.

episodes.title: Samuhik Vivah ka Sach
episodes.overview: A mass marriage scheme exposes a shocking trafficking racket. As Kuldeep closes in on the culprits, his investigation puts influential leaders and Shanvika in the spotlight.

episodes.title: Sach ki Talaash aur Satta ki Jung
episodes.overview: Set on uncovering the mass marriage scandal, Kuldeep gets attacked. Shanvika focuses on strengthening her public image. Kuldeep faces a tense confrontation with MLA Trilochan.

episodes.title: Badla ya Usool!
episodes.overview: Shanvika's political empire is at stake. Bansal and Rathore worry about getting exposed. Kuldeep begins the hunt for the truth and shakes the foundations of Sitaarpur's politics.

episodes.title: Saboot Nikalo
episodes.overview: Shanvika and her family worry about their political image after Kuldeep shows proof of the conspiracy. While Bansal and Rathore try to erase it, Kuldeep vows to expose the guilty.

episodes.title: Mala aur Do Kaand!
episodes.overview: Preeti uncovers a major secret involving Mala and Sadhu, but this puts her life in danger. While Daddu begins to suspect Kuldeep, Shanvika's enemies continue to plot against her.

episodes.title: Mastermind!
episodes.overview: Sitaarpur's mass wedding racket is exposed, implicating Home Minister Vishal Tikariya. As Mala is suspected of Pintu's and Kuldeep's dad's murders, Preeti's life is threatened.

episodes.title: Personal Ambition
episodes.overview: Prerna joins hands with Rantej to undermine Shanvika's political rise. As Pushkar suspects a traitor within, a hidden informant threatens to expose their conspiracy.

episodes.title: Bohot Hua Natak!
episodes.overview: Kuldeep refuses to frame Shanvika despite his hatred, choosing to fight her on his own terms. As he ends his fake marriage with Mala, Shanvika fears for his safety.

episodes.title: Guest Room
episodes.overview: Mala confronts Kuldeep, refusing to let go of him or their marriage. As her possessiveness grows, Kuldeep moves to the guest room while Preeti urges him to resolve the situation.

episodes.title: Charitra Hanan
episodes.overview: Rumours about Kuldeep and Shanvika threaten her reputation and family honour. Suspecting Daddu's involvement, she fights back while Kuldeep tries to evade Mala's traps.

episodes.title: Confession
episodes.overview: Sadhu's confession reveals Mala's role in Pintu's and Gendalal's murders. As power, revenge and betrayal collide, the evidence takes on a mysterious purpose.

episodes.title: Divorce
episodes.overview: Sitaarpur inaugurates its first cancer hospital as Mala signs the divorce papers. Kuldeep doubts her intentions, but a deadly confrontation changes everything.

episodes.title: Naya Daavedaar
episodes.overview: Tushar faces brutal interrogation over Sadhu's disappearance as Rantej suspects him of betrayal. Criminal Vishal Tikariya escapes and returns to Sitaarpur seeking revenge.

episodes.title: Duvidha
episodes.overview: Kuldeep risks his life for Shanvika after Vishal Tikariya abducts her. Daddu Prasad decides to launch Mala into politics. Sadhu and Kundan’s secrets become increasingly dangerous.

episodes.title: Faraar
episodes.overview: Shanvika finally chooses to fight for her love and publicly announces her decision, creating a storm within her family. Daddu, Mala, and their allies begin plotting against them.

episodes.title: Purane Pyaar ki Nayi Taseer!
episodes.overview: Shattered by her family’s denial, Shanvika leaves her home and goes to Kuldeep. Pushkar warns Kuldeep. Shanvika and Kuldeep announce their engagement, triggering furious reactions.

episodes.title: Aaj ka Suraj!
episodes.overview: Kuldeep and Shanvika head to the temple. As Pushkar is lured into a trap, Rantej's men cover the area. Pushkar gets shot and a desperate Shanvika urges Kuldeep to save her uncle.

episodes.title: Pyaar ya Vaar!
episodes.overview: After surviving the ambush, Pushkar urges Kuldeep and Shanvika to get married. Kuldeep visits his old home to seek blessings while Shanvika goes to her mother before the wedding.

episodes.title: Chauhano Ki Shaan
episodes.overview: Shanvika, the arrogant daughter of the elite Chauhan family. Kuldeep, a poor but brilliant young man. A broken bicycle leads to a meaningful exchange between the two.

episodes.title: Humse Dosti Karoge?
episodes.overview: Nakul and his cronies try to snatch Kuldeep's new bicycle from him, leading to a fight. Shanvika interferes, and she poses a question to Kuldeep.

episodes.title: Aapki Pehchan Hai Kya?
episodes.overview: Kuldeep's disinterest in her proposal makes Shanvika angry. She vows to outscore him academically, setting the stage for competition.

episodes.title: Namak Harami Mat Karna
episodes.overview:
Shanvika misbehaves with Inspector Dushyant Singh when she declares

she'll rank first in her class. Her "hard work" bears fruit, and Kuldeep goes missing. Where did he go?

episodes.title: Ishq Hua Hai!
episodes.overview: Shanvika and Kuldeep's romance blossoms. However, one day, Pushkar and his men bust their blissful moment, leading to tension between the families.

episodes.title: Galti Hamari Nahi Thi
episodes.overview: Shanvika's declaration leads to Kuldeep's family being humiliated in public. They flee for life after Pushkar sets fire to their house, but Simmi's tragic step shatters them.

episodes.title: Saaye Mai Dhoop
episodes.overview: Kuldeep starts driving a rickshaw for a living. Prerna, a passenger preparing for the UPSC exams, inspires him to reflect on his dreams and look forward to a bright future.

episodes.title: Namak Haram
episodes.overview: Family pressures Shanvika into marrying Dushyant reluctantly. Kuldeep focuses on studies but faces devastation after a fateful call.

episodes.title: Tu Hoga Kamyaab
episodes.overview: Shanvika's rejection of Dushyant on their wedding night sparks turmoil. Kuldeep grapples with inner conflicts as Prerna guides him to harness his anger constructively.

episodes.title: Chaman Mein Deedawar
episodes.overview: Kuldeep's life hangs in the balance as he faces his UPSC final interview and his mother's coma. The UPSC results bring a shocking revelation, especially those in Sitaarpur.

episodes.title: Mera Lakshya Kuch Aur Hai
episodes.overview: Kuldeep's political return sparks chaos when he proposes building a bridge in a Chauhan area. Daddu proposes an easy way for him to do it.

episodes.title: Astitwa ki Ladai
episodes.overview: Under Kuldeep's orders, all boating operations are sealed, paving the way for the bridge project. During his and Mala's wedding, tensions escalate with the arrival of the Chauhans.

episodes.title: Bhoot, Bhavishya, Vartaman
episodes.overview: The Chauhans are infuriated seeing Dushyant guarding Kuldeep. Mala speaks to her new husband about their future. The Chauhan's face losses when their businesses are raided.

episodes.title: Woh Badla Lene Hi Aaya Hai
episodes.overview: Dushyant warns Shanvika of Kuldeep's desire for revenge but she refuses to engage. Fed up with Kuldeep's high handed behaviour, the Chauhans hire Gauri to kill him.

episodes.title: Kuch Bachna Nahi Chahiye
episodes.overview: Gauri, on the run from the police, is abducted by unknown men. He urgently contacts Angad to meet the Chauhans at their hideout. Meanwhile, Kuldeep raids the Chauhan's house

episodes.title: Ghar Ka Malik Bhag Chala
episodes.overview: The Chauhan brothers surrender, which creates a sensation. In prison, Manohar wonders about his past actions. Meanwhile, Kuldeep throws a party and invites Dushyant and Shanvika

episodes.title: Ab Apna Rasta Badal Lo
episodes.overview: Dushyant decides to resign, but Kuldeep refuses and makes an offer. Gendalal warns Kuldeep about Daddu, who has a different plan for Chauhan's son in law.

episodes.title: Sab Kuch Khatam Ho Gaya
episodes.overview: Daddu instructs SP Mishra to apprehend Pushkar, but he flees. Shanvika consoles a troubled Dushyant. Kuldeep meets his childhood friend Pintu, who advises him.

episodes.title: Ab Humari Baari
episodes.overview: Kuldeep finally learns why Shanvika lied about their relationship. Tragedy strikes yet again, and Shanvika has no choice but to pick up the pieces of her shattered life.

items.title: Reacher
items.overview: Jack Reacher, a veteran military police investigator, has just recently entered civilian life. Reacher is a drifter, carrying no phone and the barest of essentials as he travels the country and explores the nation he once served.
items.description: Jack Reacher, a veteran military police investigator, has just recently entered civilian life. Reacher is a drifter, carrying no phone and the barest of essentials as he travels the country and explores the nation he once served.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Based on "Killing Floor," when retired Military Police Officer Jack Reacher is arrested for a murder he did not commit, he finds himself in the middle of a deadly conspiracy full of dirty cops, shady businessmen and scheming politicians. With nothing but his wits, he must figure out what is happening in Margrave, Georgia.

episodes.title: Welcome to Margrave
episodes.overview: Reacher is wrongly accused of murder while visiting the small town of Margrave, GA.

episodes.title: First Dance
episodes.overview: When more victims are discovered, Reacher attempts to get answers but is set up. Roscoe receives a threatening message.

episodes.title: Spoonful
episodes.overview: Reacher and Finlay’s investigation into the missing Spivey leads them into a confrontation with Kliner Sr. Roscoe learns unsettling news about Reacher.

episodes.title: In a Tree
episodes.overview: As the danger increases, Reacher and Roscoe grow closer and they make plans to meet with their contact from Homeland Security.

episodes.title: No Apologies
episodes.overview: As the mystery deepens, Reacher teams up with an old colleague and Finlay makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Papier
episodes.overview: As the town is rocked by another murder, Reacher heads to New York and learns the truth about the illegal business in Margrave while Roscoe faces danger in the woods.

episodes.title: Reacher Said Nothing
episodes.overview: Reacher springs a trap and then gets trapped himself.

episodes.title: Pie
episodes.overview: Reacher leads a rescue mission at the warehouse that ends in a showdown.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Based on "Bad Luck and Trouble," when members of Reacher's old military unit start turning up dead, Reacher has just one thing on his mind—revenge.

episodes.title: ATM
episodes.overview: Reacher and Neagley investigate the murder of a member of 110th, a group of Special investigators assembled by Reacher, only to realize the whole unit may be at risk.

episodes.title: What Happens in Atlantic City
episodes.overview: The investigation into Franz's murder takes Reacher and the surviving members of his former Army unit to Atlantic City where the mystery deepens, danger awaits, and an old flame is rekindled.

episodes.title: Picture Says a Thousand Words
episodes.overview: After more of his friends fall victim, Reacher forges an uneasy alliance with a dogged detective, and their only clue in the case leads the 110th to a troubling discovery.

episodes.title: A Night at the Symphony
episodes.overview: Reacher and his team head to Boston to track down a political aide with insider knowledge of a top secret military-defense contract that may be the reason behind their friends' deaths.

episodes.title: Burial
episodes.overview: Neagley and Dixon discover shocking information about an old friend in Denver while Reacher and O'Donnell learn more about the nefarious and mysterious A.M..

episodes.title: New York's Finest
episodes.overview: As the mystery continues to unfold, Reacher and his team set a trap to even the score.

episodes.title: The Man Goes Through
episodes.overview: As the team close in on Langston, two members of the 110th face danger, compelling Reacher to devise a dangerous plan to rescue them.

episodes.title: Fly Boy
episodes.overview: Reacher and Neagley make a final desperate attempt to save O’Donnell and Dixon, stop A.M. and avenge their friends’ murder.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Based on "Persuader," Reacher hurtles into the dark heart of a vast criminal enterprise when trying to rescue an undercover DEA informant whose time is running out. There he finds a world of secrecy and violence—and confronts some unfinished business from his own past.

episodes.title: Persuader
episodes.overview: Reacher's attempt to thwart a kidnapping brings him into contact with mysterious businessman Zachary Beck.

episodes.title: Truckin'
episodes.overview: Tasked with transporting cargo for his new employer Zachary Beck, Reacher must juggle the involvement of the DEA and a nosy new associate.

episodes.title: Number 2 with a Bullet
episodes.overview: As a rising body count threatens his undercover position, Reacher makes a dangerous play to secure Beck's trust.

episodes.title: Dominique
episodes.overview: Reacher reunites with Duffy and Villanueva and finally shares the painful details of his history with Xavier Quinn.

episodes.title: Smackdown
episodes.overview: When a DEA tragedy puts the entire mission at risk, Reacher, Duffy, and Villanueva improvise a drastic plan to save their cover.

episodes.title: Smoke on the Water
episodes.overview: Reacher is torn between his desire to kill Quinn and his promise to Duffy to save Teresa.

episodes.title: L.A. Story
episodes.overview: After Reacher and Duffy travel to Los Angeles to arrange a deal, Neagley arrives in Maine to help Reacher get answers.

episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.overview: Reacher finally faces off with both Paulie and Quinn.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Based on "Gone Tomorrow," when a chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a subway goes horribly wrong, Jack Reacher is drawn into a complex and deadly game that pits him against ruthless foes from the highest echelons of power.

episodes.title: City of Brotherly Love
episodes.overview: A chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a Philadelphia subway car draws Jack Reacher into a deadly mystery involving a missing flash drive that contains secrets worth killing for.

episodes.title: Cage Fight
episodes.overview: Tamara finds herself caught up in the mystery whether she likes it or not as she, Reacher, and Jacob face off against shady government agents and a mysterious squad of professional soldiers all looking for the same missing flash drive.

episodes.title: One Small Step
episodes.overview: Reacher learns that things are more complex than they seem as he and Lila draw closer. Meanwhile, Tamara, Jacob, and Plum find an important clue after another attack from one of their mysterious adversaries sends them back to Philadelphia.

episodes.title: Karambits and Pieces
episodes.overview: Reacher interrogates Sampson, Tamara breaks into a government facility, Jacob receives some crushing news and the team learns a piece of information that changes everything.

episodes.title: Bridge
episodes.overview: After a misunderstanding, Reacher becomes Philadelphia's Most Wanted. Meanwhile, old enemies catch up with him and new ones emerge. Jacob, Tamara and Plum end up in a firefight, giving Jacob his first real shot at avenging his sister's death.

episodes.title: Plum Out of Luck
episodes.overview: Fleeing the police, Reacher and Tamara head out-of-town to find the mysterious Ahlquist only to run into more trouble. Meanwhile, Jacob and Plum deal with their own problems back in Philadelphia.

episodes.title: Vote for Sampson
episodes.overview: Reacher and Tamara finally get the answers they've been looking for. Meanwhile, Jacob learns that their problems are just beginning when Plum's sources come through with some timely information.

episodes.title: Cut
episodes.overview: Reacher, Tamara and Jacob take the fight to the enemy as the full extent of their plot is revealed. Reacher faces off with those responsible for Anna's death while Jacob faces a moment of truth and Plum gets his shot at redemption.

items.title: Resort
items.overview: A debt-ridden room service boy rises to challenge a ruthless kitchen at a luxurious beachside haven.
items.description: A debt-ridden room service boy rises to challenge a ruthless kitchen at a luxurious beachside haven.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A 12th-fail room service boy rises to challenge a ruthless kitchen at a luxurious beachside haven.

episodes.title: Hell's Kitchen
episodes.overview: Vetri is a village boy burdened by his family responsibilities. His journey begins at RR Resort, where he comes face-to-face with Nedumaran, the resort kitchen's dictator.

episodes.title: Unwitting Actions
episodes.overview: Pandi guides Vetri through the resort to familiarise him with how things work there. Later, Aishu is harshly punished by Nedumaran because of Vetri's careless mistake.

episodes.title: The Lid is Lifted
episodes.overview: Vetri gets an opportunity to earn a living with his cooking. He comes across Nedumaran's signature soup. Meanwhile, an influencer couple raises a ruckus in the resort.

episodes.title: Doomed
episodes.overview: Nedumaran is enraged when Rajan speaks about cost-cutting. Vetri further aggravates his mood by selling his soup recipe from a street cart. Will Vetri survive Nedumaran's wrath?

episodes.title: Be Irreplaceable
episodes.overview: Nedumaran fumes as an inexperienced Vetri cracks his signature dish recipe. His plea to join the kitchen team is denied. Joji enjoys Vetri's Rasam rice. A prank on Aishu backfires.

episodes.title: Behind the Mask
episodes.overview: Joji tells Vetri that his Rasam rice reminded him of his college love. Aishu tries to sabotage Vetri's service by changing the dishes. Vetri finds out about Aishu's secret life.

episodes.title: Wave of Nostalgia
episodes.overview: Vetri plays cupid for Joji. Vetri's effort to make peace with Aishu fails. Aishu panics when she learns that Vetri is aware of her masked secret. Riya tries to patch up with Aishu.

episodes.title: Ghost from the Past
episodes.overview: Vetri helps Aishu and Veni with his cooking skills. Furious at first, Nedumaran is surprised when he tastes Vetri's dish. Later, he is shocked to learn who Vetri's father is.

episodes.title: Frozen in Fear
episodes.overview: Foreign guests like Vetri's dish, and he gets considered for the kitchen team. However, this opportunity rattles others in the kitchen.

episodes.title: Opportunity or Adversity?
episodes.overview: Nedumaran's decision about Vetri's entry into the kitchen shocks everyone. Will Vetri be up for the challenge?

episodes.title: Gearing Up
episodes.overview: Riya checks into the resort to comfort herself. Meanwhile, among gifts and sleeplessness, Vetri eagerly anticipates his big day in the kitchen.

episodes.title: Lifeblood of the Kitchen
episodes.overview: All prepared, Vetri delegates the day's menu to the kitchen staff. However, the new chef faces many struggles, the worst being the interruption of gas supply.

episodes.title: Sense of Schadenfreude
episodes.overview: Vetri rises to the challenge by using firewood stove and wins praises for the lunch menu. Seeing the kitchen's condition, Nedumaran throws Vetri out and is happy about his failure.

episodes.title: Fresh Ally
episodes.overview: Vetri's special Biryani request from the guests is rejected. Aishu stands up for Vetri when Vicky mocks him. She makes an appeal when Vetri and Pandi visit the bar where she sings.

episodes.title: Comeuppance
episodes.overview: The room service team gets targeted by the kitchen team after Vetri's failure. While Nedumaran announces Aishu as the new Sous Chef, he punishes Vicky for his reckless behaviour.

episodes.title: Covetous Desire
episodes.overview: Veni confronts Aishu for going against Vicky. Nedumaran feigns joy when Ragupathi informs him about handing over the resort to Riya. Deepak's announcement at the party shocks Riya.

episodes.title: The Good Girl Syndrome
episodes.overview: Ragupathi watches Riya being tortured by Deepak. Vetri and Aishu cook a special dish for Joji's date with his lady love. Aishu tries to tell her dad about her passion for singing.

episodes.title: Emotional Armour
