items.title: Our Sticky Love
items.overview: An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?
items.description: An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Go Eun-sae wakes up in the hospital with no recollection of who she is. Suddenly, scruffy-looking Jang Tae-ha shows up claiming to be her boyfriend.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: From quirky villagers to shady little details, everything feels off to Eun-sae — especially Tae-ha. Later, she tries to figure out if he can be trusted.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Tae-ha takes Eun-sae on a fun day out to cheer her up. However, news starts to get back to mafia boss Baek Sang-gil about what happened with Eun-sae.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Eun-sae heads to Seoul in search of answers, only to be confronted with the ugly truth about who she used to be — and the painful past of Tae-ha.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Eun-sae and Tae-ha's relationship grows sweeter, but some sticky encounters with Tae-ha's old friends put their newfound intimacy to the test.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Tiny misunderstandings snowball into wild rumors all over town. The village trio tries to fix it, only to worsen things — and Eun-sae corners Tae-ha.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: When Eun-sae vanishes, the village searches for her. Meanwhile, her doctor An Gi-jun turns up at Tae-ha's door at night with questions about her past.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Sang-gil finally realizes what Tae-ha has done. Realizing Eun-sae's safety is in danger, Tae-ha makes plans to help her escape.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.overview: With her memories revived, Eun-sae buckles down on her plan to go after Sang-gil. But her very existence now puts the whole town in danger — Tae-ha included.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Eun-sae busies herself with putting Sang-gil away. But with Eun-sae held up at work, Tae-ha wonders if there's any space left for him in her life.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Tae-ha and Eun-sae reunite with everyone in the village, but things take a turn when Sang-gil shows up — only to discover a shocking truth.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Tae-ha confronts Sang-gil to save his grandmother. Despite Sang-gil's constant threats, will Tae-ha and Eun-sae stay happily stuck together forever?

items.title: Bigg Boss OTT
items.overview: Sass aur Sazish, Drama aur Romance... itna over the top ke TV pe ban ho jayega! Karan Johar flags off the first-ever, the digital-only season of Bigg Boss with the bigg promise of gossip, controversies & uncensored drama. And let's just say... he's going to take it ALL #OverTheTop!
items.description: Sass aur Sazish, Drama aur Romance... itna over the top ke TV pe ban ho jayega! Karan Johar flags off the first-ever, the digital-only season of Bigg Boss with the bigg promise of gossip, controversies & uncensored drama. And let's just say... he's going to take it ALL #OverTheTop!

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Bigg Boss OTT, also known as Bigg Boss: Over-The-Top, is the first season of the Indian reality TV series Bigg Boss to be made for and aired on a streaming platform exclusively.

episodes.title: An 'Over the Top' launch!
episodes.overview: Stay glued to your seats as Bollywood icon Karan Johar brings to you the thirteen players, who battle it out in this unique season of Bigg Boss OTT! Tune in to this grand opening and witness the show like never before, on Voot!

episodes.title: Pehla task, pehla jhagda!
episodes.overview: Day 01: The first BIGGEST fight of the season is here! Aisa kya hua Pratik aur Divya ke beech? Will the other gharwale intervene? Watch the first exciting episode, on Voot!

episodes.title: Massive Fight! Pratik Vs Shamita
episodes.overview: Day 02: Shamita Shetty loses her cool and flares at Pratik Sehajpal when he sarcastically refers to her as a cook. Furious, Shamita accuses Pratik of bossing around and disrespecting women! Watch the argument as it goes completely OTT, on Voot!

episodes.title: Shamita-Raqesh Ki Jodi Fail?
episodes.overview: They seemed like a match made in heaven, but Sima Aunty has a different opinion on their connection! Is Shamita Shetty and Raqesh Bapat's jodi, a bigg failure? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: Zeeshan dumps Urfi!
episodes.overview: Day 04: Zeeshan Khan turns the table around when he choose Divya Agarwal as his partner and dumps Urfi Javed straight to elimination. Consequently, Urfi fumes with rage and hurls abusive remarks towards him. Watch the drama unfold, on Voot!

episodes.title: Divya loses her calm
episodes.overview: Day 5: Divya Agarwal loses her composure when the task takes an unexpected turn, and she is forced to break character. Will Divya channelise all the rage into the task and emerge victoriously? Watch the drama unfold, on Voot!

episodes.title: Ridhima-Pratik's fiery fight!
episodes.overview: Day 6: Ridhima Pandit lashes at Pratik Sehajpal when he criticises her for not washing the dishes the previous night. From accusing Pratik of bossing around the housemates to showering him with cuss words, watch the episode for Ridhima's outburst!

episodes.title: Sunday Ka Vaar, KJO style!
episodes.overview: From Karan Johar’s tadkewala vaar to SidNaaz’s masti in the Bigg Boss house and the first ever OTT elimination, this Sunday Ka Vaar just got a whole lot interesting! Tune in now.

episodes.title: SidNaaz ka jaadu chal gaya
episodes.overview: It’s that time again, Sidharth Shukla and Shehnaaz Gill are in the BB house and their chemistry is just OTT! Will their sizzling chemistry turn up the heat between the contestants in the house? Tune in to find out.

episodes.title: Ridhima Vs Pratik - The Bigg Bawal
episodes.overview: Day 09: What happened when Pratik Sehajpal accused Ridhima Pandit of being 'kaamchor'? A BIGG bawal! An otherwise composed Ridhima has a shocking meltdown that shakes up the entire house. Watch this dramatic episode now.

episodes.title: 'Spineless' Jibe Makes Raqesh CRY
episodes.overview: Day 10: From calling him spineless to accusing him of never sticking to his decisions, Pratik Sehajpal attacked Raqesh Bapat like never before! Will Raqesh take these insults lying low, or will he retaliate? Find out now, on Voot!

episodes.title: Raqesh-Shamita ne palti game!
episodes.overview: Day 12: Sanchalak duo Shamita Shetty and Raqesh Bapat have decided to take their roles VERY seriously. The result? The rest of the housemates feel the heat.. OTT Style!

episodes.title: The Biggest Brawl Yet!
episodes.overview: Starboy Zeeshan gets into an argument with all-time angry young man Pratik! What follows will blow your mind. Watch the latest episode now.

episodes.title: Tameez Seekhiye Zeeshan, Varna...
episodes.overview: Ouch! What made Akshara hurl this scathing insult at Zeeshan? An unwarranted order topped with a ton of attitude! The result? An explosive fight between the two power-packed personalities that left the housemates and the crew SHOOK!

episodes.title: Sunday Ka Vaar
episodes.overview: Sassy Karan ke teekhe bol, Hina Khan ki khubsurat aada aur Rakhi ka OTT andaaz! Get ready for entertainment ka triple dose. Watch the high-voltage action in the Bigg Boss house in this super loaded weekend episode.

episodes.title: Hina Ke Swag Ne Lagayi Aag
episodes.overview: Look who's here to stir some classic controversy! Hina Khan... and this time her teekha tadka might just brew up a storm. Hina makes the housemates choose 'Sabse Bada Phattu' of the house, and guess who Moose picks? Hint: #BhagwanHaiWoh

episodes.title: Whoa! Pratik Dumps Akshara
episodes.overview: Uh-oh! Pratik Sehajpal's shocking move leaves Akshara Singh in tears. He literally breaks her heart and decides to make a NEW connection with Neha Bhasin. A total game-changer move, Pratik! Watch the episode now.

episodes.title: Grr! Akshara Aur Neha Ki Catfight
episodes.overview: Akshara Singh's nasty comment on Neha Bhasin irks everyone around! Will Neha take Akshara's mean comment lying low? Gear up for the biggest catfight of this season. Watch this episode now.

episodes.title: Brutal Brawl, Eviction Bomb!
episodes.overview: The biggest brawl in the house leaves Divya heartbroken and results in someone's surprise exit from the house? Watch the latest episode to find out who was right and who was not!

episodes.title: Gaba Wants to QUIT!
episodes.overview: "UNFAIR", shouts Milind Gaba as he storms out to Quit the show! Milind ke josh ne udda diye gharwalon ke hosh. Looks like the 'Khunkhaar Bhediya' task has woken up this sher. Watch the drama unfold.

episodes.title: Neha Calls Divya a GUNDA?
episodes.overview: Whoa! Neha ko aati hai Divya se "Gundagardi wali feeling". You think our lone wolf will take that allegation lying low? Of course not! But her reaction pisses all the housemates. Kya Divya ki manmani banegi sabki pareshani?

episodes.title: Sunday Ka Vaar: It's Sunny!
episodes.overview: Hotness alert! Sunny Leone is in the house to put the jodis through an ultimate test of 'Connections'. Baby doll ka tadka aur Karan Johar ki class, this weekend is LOADED. Watch now!

episodes.title: Sizzling Sunny's Naughty Task
episodes.overview: Sunny Leone cranks up Shamita and Raqesh's connection with a frisky task. And... It's getting super hot inside the BB house! Will the jodis be able to pass Sunny's test? Watch all this and more in the episode!

episodes.title: Dhoka 2.0! Pratik Dumps Neha?
episodes.overview: Heart-breaker Pratik is at it AGAIN! Neha ka connection hai khatre mai, as Bigg Boss gives the housemates another chance to pair up with Divya. Will Pratik take this scandalous opportunity, or will he prove everyone wrong? Catch all the action in this episode.

episodes.title: #ShaRa Ka Connection Tuta?
episodes.overview: The budding love story between Shamita Shetty and Raqesh Bapat has turned into a warzone! A few misunderstandings between the duo led to a volatile argument... and what's next? The jodi deciding to call it QUITS! Watch this emotional episode now.

episodes.title: Nia ki entry? Haye Garmi!
episodes.overview: Ooh la la! Things are heating up inside the BB House as Nia Sharma steps in. Her sizzling equation with the boys is putting their jodis in a super tough spot. Will this be a turning point for the connections? Catch all the dhamaal in this episode.

episodes.title: Nishant Aur Moose Ki Takraar
episodes.overview: Known to be always in sync, Nishant and Moose today are at loggerheads. The reason you ask? A sacred friendship. Will this feisty clash of opinions ruin their connection? Find out in this episode!

episodes.title: Ghar Se Aaye Letters!
episodes.overview: Emotions are at an all-time high in the Bigg Boss house. Personal letters are here from the families of the housemates, but with an unexpected TWIST! Who will bear the brunt of this twist? Find out in this episode.

episodes.title: Sunday Ka Power-Packed Vaar
episodes.overview: Your favourite hotties Rubina Dilaik and Nikki Tamboli are back in the Bigg Boss house and they are adding a teekha tadka! What's more? Unwrap the sin with Karan Johar and the team of Voot Select Original 'Candy' in this action-packed Sunday Ka Vaar.

episodes.title: Nishant calls Shamita 'Ghamandi'
episodes.overview: Ice queen! Ghamandi! Nishant is running wild with his accusations on Shamita. The feud escalated when the two were given a simple task. Soon, Nishant while guarding his dearest friend went all guns blazing on Shamita. Watch this epic feud now.

episodes.title: Bigg Shocker For Housemates!
episodes.overview: A twist we never saw coming! Goodbye to all the connections and welcome to the GAME. While Divya is celebrating, others are in a spot of bother. Will this change the dynamics forever? Watch this shocking episode now.

episodes.title: It's WAR! Shamita & Divya's Catfight
episodes.overview: Newsflash! Shamita and Divya just can't stand each other. A brutal strike in the task has got the divas sparring once again - and it's getting uglier. What's next for these friends turned sworn enemies? Find out in this catty episode.

episodes.title: Race For The Ticket To Finale!
episodes.overview: Shots are fired and now it's time for action! The ticket to finale task is in session and the housemates are playing the game, OTT style! From verbal crossfires to physical fights, watch out for this race to the finale.

episodes.title: Pratik makes Divya lose it all
episodes.overview: Moose Jattana's decision to side with Raqesh Bapat in the Ticket To Finale task makes Pratik Sehajpal very angry. He refuses to follow the house rules. The result? Bigg Boss cancels the ENTIRE task and Divya Agarwal loses her advantage to the finale! Uh oh! Yeh kya kiya Pratik?

episodes.title: #ShaRa Aur Woh!
episodes.overview: Uh-oh! The most complicated love triangle of Shamita-Raqesh-Divya is back in the spotlight. All Shamita has ever wanted is for Raqesh to stay away from Divya, but the effect is quite the opposite. Will Shamita be able to shake her jealous rage? Watch the melodrama now!

episodes.title: Star-Studded Sunday Ka Vaar
episodes.overview: Neha Kakkar and Tony Kakkar are coming in hot with their entertainment ka kaanta! What's more? Varun Sood is also here to support his other half, Divya Agarwal! Brace up for a shandaar Sunday ka vaar!

episodes.title: Jab Divya Met Varun
episodes.overview: Divya Agarwal gets a sweet surprise from her boo, Varun Sood. A stern warning for the gharwale and a kiss of love for his "baby". Eyes on the prize, Divya! Excited for the OTT finale week? Stay tuned.

episodes.title: Emo Alert! Try Not To Cry
episodes.overview: Our lovely finalists will REUNITE with their families tonight and it's going to be one hell of an emotional ride. Kya hoga jab gharwalon se milenge unke gharwale? Tune in to watch Bigg Boss OTT NOW!

episodes.title: Shamita Par 'Insecurity' Ka Aarop?
episodes.overview: Burning questions from the press leaves the finalists sore. Shamita is grilled for being "insecure" - after all Raqesh and Divya are just friends. Will Shamita hold on to her feelings or will she move on? All this and more scandalous topics will be addressed. Catch all the masaledaar drama of the finale week.

episodes.title: Midnight Eviction Ka Jhatka!
episodes.overview: The brutal race to the top begins! In an unexpected twist, Bigg Boss puts the finalists through a horrifying midnight eviction. The door to the finals will open only for one - Raqesh or Neha? Watch this heartbreaking episode now!

episodes.title: Yaadon Ka Pitaara
episodes.overview: Savage fights, mushy love and solid friendships, the housemates have done it all. Now it's time to look at their remarkable ride and decide if those memories are worth keeping or can they let it go? Watch this sentimental episode now! Warning: This one is a total tear-jerker.

episodes.title: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: 5 strong finalists, 1 Bigg Boss OTT trophy and only one will walk away as the winner of the first ever season of Bigg Boss OTT. Brace yourselves for an entertainment extravaganza with Karan Johar, Ritiesh and Genelia Deshmukh. Now that's what we call an OTT Grand Finale!

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: This time, Janta is the ASLI BOSS! High-octane multi-camera 24 hours LIVE channel, action-packed latest episodes and get to make crucial decisions for the housemates – all this and more on this season of Bigg Boss OTT. Get ready to experience Bigg Boss OTT Like Never Before!

episodes.title: Grand Premiere
episodes.overview: Wild contestants, crazy performances and Salman's epic swag - it doesn't get bigger than this! Watch the Grand Premiere of the biggest reality show ever, Bigg Boss OTT.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Ab sab badlega, mausam badlega, taapman badlega rules naye game wahi - Anil Kapoor ke aane se sab badlega. 24 hours LIVE channel, action-packed latest episodes – all this and more on this season of Bigg Boss OTT. Get ready to experience Bigg Boss OTT Season 3 streaming at 9 PM from 21st June onwards!

episodes.title: Grand Premiere
episodes.overview: Kaunse celebrities gaye hai ghar ke andar khelne yeh twists or turns-wali game? Anil Kapoor ke saath find out now in this jhakaas opening episode.

episodes.title: Kaun Hai ‘Janta Ka Agent’?
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss welcomed all the contestants into the house, referring to them as "GHARWALAS," but hinted that this season, one person would be the "Baharwala" – AKA Janta ka agent. Who is that “Baharwaala”?

episodes.title: Food Portion Par Debate
episodes.overview: Ranvir aur Chandrika ke beech mein veg aur non-veg portions ko lekar ho rahi hai jamkar bahas. Kya Ranvir ki soch hai sahi ya Chandrika ki samajhdari? Don't miss the excitement of the latest episode of BB OTT Season 3.

episodes.title: Season Ka Pehla Nomination
episodes.overview: Masti mazak ke mahol mai aayi first nomination ki baari. Kon karega kisko nominate? Aur kon hoga iss hafte safe? Janne ke liye dekhte rahiye Bigg Boss OTT!

episodes.title: Shamita-Raqesh Ki Jodi Fail?
episodes.overview: They seemed like a match made in heaven, but Sima Aunty has a different opinion on their connection! Is Shamita Shetty and Raqesh Bapat's jodi, a bigg failure? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: Zeeshan dumps Urfi!
episodes.overview: Day 04: Zeeshan Khan turns the table around when he choose Divya Agarwal as his partner and dumps Urfi Javed straight to elimination. Consequently, Urfi fumes with rage and hurls abusive remarks towards him. Watch the drama unfold, on Voot!

episodes.title: Divya loses her calm
episodes.overview: Day 5: Divya Agarwal loses her composure when the task takes an unexpected turn, and she is forced to break character. Will Divya channelise all the rage into the task and emerge victoriously? Watch the drama unfold, on Voot!

episodes.title: Ridhima-Pratik's fiery fight!
episodes.overview: Day 6: Ridhima Pandit lashes at Pratik Sehajpal when he criticises her for not washing the dishes the previous night. From accusing Pratik of bossing around the housemates to showering him with cuss words, watch the episode for Ridhima's outburst!

episodes.title: Sunday Ka Vaar, KJO style!
episodes.overview: From Karan Johar’s tadkewala vaar to SidNaaz’s masti in the Bigg Boss house and the first ever OTT elimination, this Sunday Ka Vaar just got a whole lot interesting! Tune in now.

episodes.title: SidNaaz ka jaadu chal gaya
episodes.overview: It’s that time again, Sidharth Shukla and Shehnaaz Gill are in the BB house and their chemistry is just OTT! Will their sizzling chemistry turn up the heat between the contestants in the house? Tune in to find out.

episodes.title: Ridhima Vs Pratik - The Bigg Bawal
episodes.overview: Day 09: What happened when Pratik Sehajpal accused Ridhima Pandit of being 'kaamchor'? A BIGG bawal! An otherwise composed Ridhima has a shocking meltdown that shakes up the entire house. Watch this dramatic episode now.

episodes.title: 'Spineless' Jibe Makes Raqesh CRY
episodes.overview: Day 10: From calling him spineless to accusing him of never sticking to his decisions, Pratik Sehajpal attacked Raqesh Bapat like never before! Will Raqesh take these insults lying low, or will he retaliate? Find out now, on Voot!

episodes.title: Raqesh-Shamita ne palti game!
episodes.overview: Day 12: Sanchalak duo Shamita Shetty and Raqesh Bapat have decided to take their roles VERY seriously. The result? The rest of the housemates feel the heat.. OTT Style!

episodes.title: The Biggest Brawl Yet!
episodes.overview: Starboy Zeeshan gets into an argument with all-time angry young man Pratik! What follows will blow your mind. Watch the latest episode now.

episodes.title: Tameez Seekhiye Zeeshan, Varna...
episodes.overview: Ouch! What made Akshara hurl this scathing insult at Zeeshan? An unwarranted order topped with a ton of attitude! The result? An explosive fight between the two power-packed personalities that left the housemates and the crew SHOOK!

episodes.title: Sunday Ka Vaar
episodes.overview: Sassy Karan ke teekhe bol, Hina Khan ki khubsurat aada aur Rakhi ka OTT andaaz! Get ready for entertainment ka triple dose. Watch the high-voltage action in the Bigg Boss house in this super loaded weekend episode.

episodes.title: Hina Ke Swag Ne Lagayi Aag
episodes.overview: Look who's here to stir some classic controversy! Hina Khan... and this time her teekha tadka might just brew up a storm. Hina makes the housemates choose 'Sabse Bada Phattu' of the house, and guess who Moose picks? Hint: #BhagwanHaiWoh

episodes.title: Whoa! Pratik Dumps Akshara
episodes.overview: Uh-oh! Pratik Sehajpal's shocking move leaves Akshara Singh in tears. He literally breaks her heart and decides to make a NEW connection with Neha Bhasin. A total game-changer move, Pratik! Watch the episode now.

episodes.title: Grr! Akshara Aur Neha Ki Catfight
episodes.overview: Akshara Singh's nasty comment on Neha Bhasin irks everyone around! Will Neha take Akshara's mean comment lying low? Gear up for the biggest catfight of this season. Watch this episode now.

episodes.title: Brutal Brawl, Eviction Bomb!
episodes.overview: The biggest brawl in the house leaves Divya heartbroken and results in someone's surprise exit from the house? Watch the latest episode to find out who was right and who was not!

episodes.title: Gaba Wants to QUIT!
episodes.overview: "UNFAIR", shouts Milind Gaba as he storms out to Quit the show! Milind ke josh ne udda diye gharwalon ke hosh. Looks like the 'Khunkhaar Bhediya' task has woken up this sher. Watch the drama unfold.

episodes.title: Neha Calls Divya a GUNDA?
episodes.overview: Whoa! Neha ko aati hai Divya se "Gundagardi wali feeling". You think our lone wolf will take that allegation lying low? Of course not! But her reaction pisses all the housemates. Kya Divya ki manmani banegi sabki pareshani?

episodes.title: Sunday Ka Vaar: It's Sunny!
episodes.overview: Hotness alert! Sunny Leone is in the house to put the jodis through an ultimate test of 'Connections'. Baby doll ka tadka aur Karan Johar ki class, this weekend is LOADED. Watch now!

episodes.title: Sizzling Sunny's Naughty Task
episodes.overview: Sunny Leone cranks up Shamita and Raqesh's connection with a frisky task. And... It's getting super hot inside the BB house! Will the jodis be able to pass Sunny's test? Watch all this and more in the episode!

episodes.title: Dhoka 2.0! Pratik Dumps Neha?
episodes.overview: Heart-breaker Pratik is at it AGAIN! Neha ka connection hai khatre mai, as Bigg Boss gives the housemates another chance to pair up with Divya. Will Pratik take this scandalous opportunity, or will he prove everyone wrong? Catch all the action in this episode.

episodes.title: #ShaRa Ka Connection Tuta?
episodes.overview: The budding love story between Shamita Shetty and Raqesh Bapat has turned into a warzone! A few misunderstandings between the duo led to a volatile argument... and what's next? The jodi deciding to call it QUITS! Watch this emotional episode now.

episodes.title: Nia ki entry? Haye Garmi!
episodes.overview: Ooh la la! Things are heating up inside the BB House as Nia Sharma steps in. Her sizzling equation with the boys is putting their jodis in a super tough spot. Will this be a turning point for the connections? Catch all the dhamaal in this episode.

episodes.title: Nishant Aur Moose Ki Takraar
episodes.overview: Known to be always in sync, Nishant and Moose today are at loggerheads. The reason you ask? A sacred friendship. Will this feisty clash of opinions ruin their connection? Find out in this episode!

episodes.title: Ghar Se Aaye Letters!
episodes.overview: Emotions are at an all-time high in the Bigg Boss house. Personal letters are here from the families of the housemates, but with an unexpected TWIST! Who will bear the brunt of this twist? Find out in this episode.

episodes.title: Sunday Ka Power-Packed Vaar
episodes.overview: Your favourite hotties Rubina Dilaik and Nikki Tamboli are back in the Bigg Boss house and they are adding a teekha tadka! What's more? Unwrap the sin with Karan Johar and the team of Voot Select Original 'Candy' in this action-packed Sunday Ka Vaar.

episodes.title: Nishant calls Shamita 'Ghamandi'
episodes.overview: Ice queen! Ghamandi! Nishant is running wild with his accusations on Shamita. The feud escalated when the two were given a simple task. Soon, Nishant while guarding his dearest friend went all guns blazing on Shamita. Watch this epic feud now.

episodes.title: Bigg Shocker For Housemates!
episodes.overview: A twist we never saw coming! Goodbye to all the connections and welcome to the GAME. While Divya is celebrating, others are in a spot of bother. Will this change the dynamics forever? Watch this shocking episode now.

episodes.title: It's WAR! Shamita & Divya's Catfight
episodes.overview: Newsflash! Shamita and Divya just can't stand each other. A brutal strike in the task has got the divas sparring once again - and it's getting uglier. What's next for these friends turned sworn enemies? Find out in this catty episode.

episodes.title: Race For The Ticket To Finale!
episodes.overview: Shots are fired and now it's time for action! The ticket to finale task is in session and the housemates are playing the game, OTT style! From verbal crossfires to physical fights, watch out for this race to the finale.

episodes.title: Pratik makes Divya lose it all
episodes.overview: Moose Jattana's decision to side with Raqesh Bapat in the Ticket To Finale task makes Pratik Sehajpal very angry. He refuses to follow the house rules. The result? Bigg Boss cancels the ENTIRE task and Divya Agarwal loses her advantage to the finale! Uh oh! Yeh kya kiya Pratik?

episodes.title: #ShaRa Aur Woh!
episodes.overview: Uh-oh! The most complicated love triangle of Shamita-Raqesh-Divya is back in the spotlight. All Shamita has ever wanted is for Raqesh to stay away from Divya, but the effect is quite the opposite. Will Shamita be able to shake her jealous rage? Watch the melodrama now!

episodes.title: Star-Studded Sunday Ka Vaar
episodes.overview: Neha Kakkar and Tony Kakkar are coming in hot with their entertainment ka kaanta! What's more? Varun Sood is also here to support his other half, Divya Agarwal! Brace up for a shandaar Sunday ka vaar!

episodes.title: Jab Divya Met Varun
episodes.overview: Divya Agarwal gets a sweet surprise from her boo, Varun Sood. A stern warning for the gharwale and a kiss of love for his "baby". Eyes on the prize, Divya! Excited for the OTT finale week? Stay tuned.

episodes.title: Emo Alert! Try Not To Cry
episodes.overview: Our lovely finalists will REUNITE with their families tonight and it's going to be one hell of an emotional ride. Kya hoga jab gharwalon se milenge unke gharwale? Tune in to watch Bigg Boss OTT NOW!

episodes.title: Shamita Par 'Insecurity' Ka Aarop?
episodes.overview: Burning questions from the press leaves the finalists sore. Shamita is grilled for being "insecure" - after all Raqesh and Divya are just friends. Will Shamita hold on to her feelings or will she move on? All this and more scandalous topics will be addressed. Catch all the masaledaar drama of the finale week.

episodes.title: Midnight Eviction Ka Jhatka!
episodes.overview: The brutal race to the top begins! In an unexpected twist, Bigg Boss puts the finalists through a horrifying midnight eviction. The door to the finals will open only for one - Raqesh or Neha? Watch this heartbreaking episode now!

episodes.title: Yaadon Ka Pitaara
episodes.overview: Savage fights, mushy love and solid friendships, the housemates have done it all. Now it's time to look at their remarkable ride and decide if those memories are worth keeping or can they let it go? Watch this sentimental episode now! Warning: This one is a total tear-jerker.

episodes.title: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: 5 strong finalists, 1 Bigg Boss OTT trophy and only one will walk away as the winner of the first ever season of Bigg Boss OTT. Brace yourselves for an entertainment extravaganza with Karan Johar, Ritiesh and Genelia Deshmukh. Now that's what we call an OTT Grand Finale!

items.title: MTV Hustle
items.overview: MTV Hustle is India's first rap reality show. Judged by Raftaar, Nucleya and Raja Kumari, it premiered on 9 August 2019. Hosted by Gaelyn Mendonca, it airs on MTV India.
items.description: MTV Hustle is India's first rap reality show. Judged by Raftaar, Nucleya and Raja Kumari, it premiered on 9 August 2019. Hosted by Gaelyn Mendonca, it airs on MTV India.

episodes.title: Let the hustle begin!
episodes.overview: From the hoods of L.A to the gullies of Mumbai, rap has become the voice of the voiceless and a symbol of living your dreams. Join Raftaar, Raja Kumari and Nucleya in the making of history as 40 aspiring emcees try their best to be the country's latest hip-hop icon. Killer bars, dope beats and a hustler's attitude, catch it all and more.

episodes.title: Naezy in awe of an O.G!
episodes.overview: Even before he drops his first bar, Raftaar cannot help but praise Hemant Dhyani, not just for his musical skills but also for his efforts in making hip-hop accessible to the underprivileged and for raising the country's next round of O.Gs through the Dharavi Project.

episodes.title: A gala at Hustle!
episodes.overview: Raja Kumari kickstarts Hustle with a bang by delivering a fantastic performance of her song 'Meera". The brilliant contestants set the stage on fire with melody, dance and lyrical masterpieces too. Watch this enthralling episode to see the names of the top 15 drop.

episodes.title: An MCs inspiring lyrical spectacle!
episodes.overview: As some of the most talented rappers spit their best verses, EPR arrives onstage and delivers a strong message through his heart-wrenching rap about suicide prevention and nearly moves Nucleya to tears. Tune in to witness EPR's sensational performance along with the judges' reactions and more.

episodes.title: Salim Merchant joins the hustlers!
episodes.overview: After a powerful and thought-provoking performance by EPR that has the judges and the audience on their feet, Salim Merchant cannot help but join him on stage to add a new twist to his lyrics and delivery style. And what follows might go down as the best performance on Hustle's stage to date. Watch their stunning performance among many others.

episodes.title: MZ Bella impresses Raftaar!
episodes.overview: The popular Indian rapper, Raga, slays the stage with his thought-provoking rap and energetic performance. Raga then clears the air with MZ Bella regarding a beef they previously had and MZ Bella leaves both Raga and Raftaar impressed with his inspiring rap performance!

episodes.title: Oh no! A blunder by Shetty Saa!
episodes.overview: It's time to bring the A game for the Hustlers as they are about to go head to head against their fellow contestants. But all this pressure to perform has a negative impact on Shetty Saa, and he forgets his lyrics midway through his performance. Will he be able to bounce back? Or is this the end to his journey?

episodes.title: Akshay and Lakshya in trouble!
episodes.overview: Lakshya Bhardwaj and Akshay Kumar get on Raftaar's bad side after their face-off goes terribly wrong. Raftaar furiously tears the lyric sheet as he reminds the two contestants that this show is not a joke. Will this incident risk their future in the competition?

episodes.title: Agsy sheds light on child abuse!
episodes.overview: Agsy sheds light on child abuse through her exquisite lyrics which brings tears to Raja Kumari. The entire crowd, contestants, and the remaining judges are touched by her expression.

episodes.title: Naezy lauds inspiring Raeza!
episodes.overview: Raeza kills the stage with her beautiful rendition towards her fellow rappers, namely EPR, Shetty Saa, and MC Heam. Being one of the youngest contestants, Raeza credits her fellow rappers for motivating her with the confidence to deliver the rap she wants to convey. All the contestants have a group hug after her performance bringing Raeza to tears of joy.

episodes.title: Brodha V in awe of RCR!
episodes.overview: Brodha V, a renowned rapper and lyricist, is here to soak in the Hustle experience. In the previous weeks, RCR delivered some emotionally charged rap performances. In contrast, he owns the stage tonight with his swagger and impresses the judges with his extremely catchy made-for-radio song. Brodha V is in awe of RCR's performance and confesses that he would listen to this song in his car on a daily basis.

episodes.title: EPR spits fire against acid!
episodes.overview: Brodha V and Raftaar kick-start the show with a powerful performance that has the audience mesmerised and wanting more. And EPR gives them what they want, with a powerful performance that pays tribute to acid attack survivors and the courage of souls like Laxmi Agarwal.

episodes.title: Shekhar to King: Please sing again!
episodes.overview: Famed Bollywood music director, Shekhar Ravjiani hits the Hustle stage to see what the competition has to offer. He is left astounded with King Rocco's performance so much that he requests him to sing again. The crowd goes wild as King manages to deliver an extravagant ensemble back to back. Tune in to this exciting episode, now on Voot!

episodes.title: All praises for Himan!
episodes.overview: Despite forgetting his lines, Himan receives high commendation from the judges for being in sync with the rap flow. Shekhar Ravjiani is so impressed with Himan's lyrics that he invites him to write for his production. Adding to Himan's happiness, Nucleya also wishes to collaborate with him after the show. Watch his amazing performance and more, now on Voot!

episodes.title: King's rule prevails!
episodes.overview: Being an avid fan of King, guest Bobby Friction calls him out to be the first performer of the night. Well, King does not disappoint! He drops a show-stopping performance that has the judges and the audience on their feet swaying to his rhythm. Watch King open with a stunner followed by other great performances and a dazzling opener from L-Fresh the Lion and MC Mirrah in this episode.

episodes.title: Tribute to a soldier's wife!
episodes.overview: Shloka is back with a bang and has the Hustle house wrapped in strong patriotic vibe with his ode to the brave wives of the soldiers. Touching on their suspenseful life and how she becomes part of the soldier's sacrifice for the country, experience the rollercoaster of emotions in this epic rap tribute, now on Voot!

episodes.title: Fotty Seven's rap jugalbandi!
episodes.overview: Fotty Seven opens the semi-finals with a spectacular performance and captivates the crowd. Being a massive representative of the underground rap scene, Fotty joins M-Zee Bella in a collaborative performance which takes rap to a whole new level. Tune in to this exciting episode, now on Voot!

episodes.title: Fight for the finale!
episodes.overview: King, RCR, Void, and Agsy have all their cards on the table as they fight for the last seat in the finals. All the hard work, dedication and patience has come down to this final moment that will decide their fates. Who will join EPR, M Zee Bella, and Shloka in the finale?

episodes.title: Grand finale is here!
episodes.overview: As the highly-anticipated grand finale knocks the door of MTV Hustle, the energy and excitement reaches a record breaking height with the performances by L Fresh the Lion and MC Mirrah! The contestants keep the musical spirits high with their spectacular rap as they try to gain an upper hand. Watch the first part of supremely entertaining grand finale.

episodes.title: Grand Finale: Who is the ultimate hustler?
episodes.overview: After a Hustle of three quick months and even quicker raps, it is finally the time to choose the ultimate hustler in the Grand Finale. EPR and M-Zee Bella, the two hustlers who made their way to the grand finale battle it out to win the coveted crown. But who will be crowned as the winner of the first-ever Hustle rap battle?

episodes.title: Hustle 2.0 back with a banger!
episodes.overview: MTV Hustle is back in the hood with its 'Rap-chik' swag. With Badshah, Dee MC, EPR, King and Dino James as the judges, stay tuned to see some dope hip hop content, on Voot!

episodes.title: Let the hustle begin!
episodes.overview: MTV Hustle continues to slay as the judges deliver next-level performances and set the stage on fire. Stay tuned to see the judges getting blown away by some of the power-packed raps by the MCs', on Voot!

episodes.title: A fresh wave of rap!
episodes.overview: The judges are hit by a fresh wave of rap and tap. They are blown away by the MCs' as they rock the stage with their exemplary talent and groovy moves. Tune in to this introductory round to watch them rap in style.

episodes.title: Go big or go home!
episodes.overview: Six rappers compete head-to-head in this intense battle to earn a spot in the top 20. Who will seize the chance? Watch to discover some of the incredibly powerful raps.

episodes.title: Badshah-Ikka slay the stage!
episodes.overview: While the top sixteen finalists gear up to impress the judges, Badshah welcomes his dear friend Ikka to grace the stage. Watch the musical duo slay the stage with a spectacular rap performance amidst some dynamic and spirited performances.

episodes.title: The stage goes boom, boom, boom!
episodes.overview: The stage goes boom, boom and boom with Srushti Tawade turning the notch up with her 'chill kinda guy' song. The judges are amazed by the craziness bottled up in her and appreciate her fearlessness.

episodes.title: The dreaded elimination begins!
episodes.overview: Brodha V enters the show in style and joins Badshah as the guest judge. As the elimination commences, Badshah gives Dee MC a special power for being the squad of the week in the previous episode. Who will be eliminated first?

episodes.title: Rhyme-Khullar G's final face-off
episodes.overview: Rhyme and Khullar G's low scores leave them as the bottom two performers. They have to face each other in Battleground 2.0 to secure their positions in the competition with their performances. Who will achieve success, and whose journey ends tonight?

episodes.title: Badshah is shook!
episodes.overview: Badshah is forced to leave his seat out of exhilaration after Srushti Tawde and MC Square deliver one banger after another. Later, Badshah drops a bomb by revealing no more battles but a double elimination instead. Stay tuned to know more.

episodes.title: EPR receives a superpower!
episodes.overview: Rhyme, GD 47 and LXSH face the tough eliminations for securing low scores. As Badshah gives the superpower to EPR to save a contestant, who will EPR save? Watch the episode.

episodes.title: Srushti nahi toh kaun?
episodes.overview: Srushti Tawde levels up with her rap game, keeping it very transparent about her struggles of writing, and also mimicking the other artists. Watch her enjoy the praises of the judges.

episodes.title: Dino Warriors get a superpower
episodes.overview: Wicked Sunny and Gravity's performances help the Dino Warriors become the Squad of the week. Badshah announces that they will receive a special power as a prize for this win. What will the prize be?

episodes.title: Shout-out week special
episodes.overview: Badshah announces a special week of Shout-outs and welcomes Encore and Calm as the special judges. Later, MC Square rocks the stage with his folk and hip-hop rap. Catch more special shout-out performances in this episode.

episodes.title: Gravity sings through the pain!
episodes.overview: Even though Gravity's father passed away recently, he doesn't let it stop him from giving his best onstage. Later, he wins the performer of the week title and also helps his squad become the squad of the week. What will his squad receive as a reward?

episodes.title: Badshah throws his chair onstage!
episodes.overview: Rappers from each team deliver energetic performances during the collaboration week special. Later, after seeing Paradox and MC Square's performance, Badshah is extremely impressed and throws his chair on the stage.

episodes.title: Badshah calls the shots!
episodes.overview: Get ready as the professionals turn industry ready and perform the challenges thrown by Badshah. The competition gets tougher as the contestants face a double elimination before the semi-finals. Watch the episode.

episodes.title: Battlegrounds 2.0 begins
episodes.overview: Badshah invites the Hustlers to the stage and reveals that only five can make it to the Grand Finale. He begins Battlegrounds 2.0, where the Hustlers have to compete against each other to earn a spot in the Finale. Watch the battles.

episodes.title: Badshah declares the finalists!
episodes.overview: As battleground 2.0 concludes with some incredible performances, Badshah compiles the scores of the contestants and announces the top five finalists for the MTV Hustle 2.0 Grand Finale.

episodes.title: Badshah kicks off the Grand Finale!
episodes.overview: Badshah welcomes the top five contestants on stage as the time has finally come to see who takes the trophy of the Hustle 2.0 home. The famous rapper, Ikka, joins him as a guest judge. With the hustlers all set, who will win the coveted title?

episodes.title: Who is the ultimate Hustler?
episodes.overview: The second day of the grand finale begins with a surprise as Dino James and Ikka perform together on stage. Later, Badshah announces the name of the winner of MTV Hustle 2.0. Who will be crowned the champion and ultimate rapper? Find out, on Voot!

episodes.title: Grand Premiere
episodes.overview: Badshah launches the new season of MTV Hustle with a rocking performance. His anticipation is finally over as he eagerly prepares to choose the outstanding rappers for the upcoming rounds. Tune in to the series premiere episode for more details.

episodes.title: Badshah's thoughts on conscious rap
episodes.overview: Badshah continues his search for remarkable rappers for the new season of MTV Hustle. Later, Rap ID showcases a conscious rap style and addresses the topic of social abuse, earning Badshah's admiration. Can Rap ID impress the other judges?

episodes.title: Burrah's melodic insights!
episodes.overview: Burrah sheds light on the pain of depression and creates a captivating atmosphere with his exquisite lyrics. Later, when EPR openly admires Burrah's songs, he feels proud. Watch this episode to witness his soulful rap.

episodes.title: The fight for survival!
episodes.overview: Today, six fierce contestants go head-to-head in two epic battles, with only two emerging victorious and the rest facing elimination. Watch the episode as they bring the heat with their mind-blowing raps to secure their spot in the show.

episodes.title: A remarkable moment for the judges
episodes.overview: Badshah invites skilled rappers, Sikander Kahlon and Raga, as special guests. Later, the judges are deeply impressed by Mrunal Shankar's exceptional rap on women empowerment. Watch the episode for more.

episodes.title: Shady Mellow's emotional lullaby!
episodes.overview: Shady Mellow touches upon a sensitive topic through his melodious rap, Ladke Rote Nahi Hain. The judges are floored by his performance and award him a radio hit. Watch the episode for more incredible performances.

episodes.title: Bassick's unique regional taste
episodes.overview: Bassick showcases a unique type of hook in "Chhaapte Chamaat Chaar," including his unique regional flair. The judges are in awe of Bassick's masterful 12-time use of the hook. Watch the episode for more incredible performances.

episodes.title: Rap ID's legendary performance!
episodes.overview: Rap ID's 'Milawat Hai' goes down as one of the most legendary performances in the history of Indian hip-hop. The judges are floored by his skills and applaud his commendable effort. Watch the episode for more!

episodes.title: Shen B Brings Everyone to Tears
episodes.overview: Salim Merchant delivers a vibrant performance alongside EPR. Later, Shen B conveys the importance of his mother, wife, and daughter through his performance, eliciting emotional reactions that move everyone to tears. Watch the episode for more.

episodes.title: It's Time for the Real Battle
episodes.overview: After receiving low scores, Shady Mellow and Bassick find themselves in the danger zone. Subsequently, they are given an opportunity to secure a safe position by competing against each other. Who will emerge victorious in this battle?

episodes.title: Uday and his Rhyme Schemes
episodes.overview: The judges are in awe of Uday's spectacular performance and applaud his perfect structuring techniques. Impressed with his wordplay, Calm and Encore ABJ invited him for a freestyle jam. Watch the episode for more incredible performances.

episodes.title: Vijay Dada's Emotional Journey
episodes.overview: Vijay Dada's rap unveils his touching life journey which evokes deep emotions in all. After earning Squad of the Week, Dino James gets the ability to shield one among Poet Shaf, Prince, and Shen B from the Ground-Shunya challenge. Who will Dino save?

episodes.title: Vijay Dada's reggae anthem!
episodes.overview: Vijay Dada floors the judges with his new rap song, Na Bro. He captures the essence of reggae music and delivers it with finesse accompanied with impeccable voice modulation. Will he win the ticket to finale?

episodes.title: The Ticket to Finale!
episodes.overview: The artists dazzle the judges with their flawless performances. Based on their flexibility and consistency, Badshah later chooses one of the five artists to receive a ticket to the finals. Who will emerge victorious?

episodes.title: It's time for some teamwork!
episodes.overview: Samantha Ruth Prabhu makes a special appearance and expresses her fondness for the show. Vijay Dada and Kayden awe the judges with their seamless blend of verses from South Indian languages. Will this duo emerge victorious?

episodes.title: A vital announcement from Samantha
episodes.overview: Samantha Ruth Prabhu draws inspiration from the hard work of the rappers and inaugurates the Tamil edition of MTV Hustle. Following this, 100 RBH and Bob B compete in a rap battle to secure a safe position on the show. Watch the episode for more.

episodes.title: The Semi Finale Rap Rumble!
episodes.overview: The battle begins as eight rappers compete for the four coveted spots in the grand finale. Subsequently, 100 RBH and Rap ID captivate the audience with their electrifying poetry and conscious rap, winning judges' hearts. Watch the episode for more.

episodes.title: The Penultimate Round
episodes.overview: With just one step away from the Grand Finale, the rappers have to give one ultimate performance to impress the audience. Tune in to the episode for more!

episodes.title: Mrunal earns grand salutes
episodes.overview: Guru Randhawa and King make a special appearance on the show to witness the electrifying performances. Later, Mrunal Shankar earns grand salutes from everyone for her remarkable efforts in reaching the grand finale. Watch the episode for more.

episodes.title: Badshah reveals the winner's name
episodes.overview: The six finalist rappers give their maximum effort to secure the title of the MTV Hustle S3. Badshah then acknowledges their dedication and unveils the name of the ultimate winner. Who will emerge victorious in this decisive showdown?

episodes.title: Season 4 opens with a BANG!
episodes.overview: Raftaar returns by popular demand on MTV Hustle, and this time, he’s not alone—joining him is his brother, his ride-or-die, his G—Ikka! Together, they launch an electrifying new season, where a fresh batch of talented Hustlers bring their A-game to earn a spot in one of the 4 coveted squads. Let the battle for supremacy begin!

episodes.title: New Hustlers, Same Fire!
episodes.overview: The heat rises as the next set of Hustlers hit the stage, spitting harder bars and chasing their shot at greatness. With Raftaar and Ikka turning up the pressure, only the best will earn a spot in the squads.

episodes.title: One step closer to Top 16
episodes.overview: The next batch of Hustlers give it their all to win over the judges and squad bosses. Watch the episode to find out which Hustlers make the cut and who all go into BattleVerse.

episodes.title: Dekh Kaun Aaya Waapis
episodes.overview: M-Zee-Bella comes back on the Hustle stage kickstarting the season’s first BattleVerse! Watch the episode to meet this season’s Top 16.

episodes.title: King of Hustle
episodes.overview: King, once again, rules over the Hustle stage as we step into Phase 2 of the competition. It's time to Level Up!

episodes.title: Hustle Pro Max
episodes.overview: The scores are in! Find out who all won over the Squad Bosses and who all move one step closer to eliminations.

episodes.title: Seedhe Maut In The House!
episodes.overview: This week it’s all about Flexing it with Seedhe Maut! Watch our Hustlers flex their culture, style and swag to stay ahead in the competition.

episodes.title: Top 16's first Elimination
episodes.overview: Things get intense as we reach the season's first elimination. From now on Hustlers either spit fire or get left in the dust.

episodes.title: Celebrations and Rhymes
episodes.overview: This week, the Hustlers bring in Raftaar’s birthday with bangers rich in storytelling and visual imagery.

episodes.title: Beats, Bars and Battle Scars
episodes.overview: Watch the Hustlers take us on a journey filled with personal stories and triumphs as they level up to the next phase of the competition.

episodes.title: Badshah of Bollywood Sampling
episodes.overview: Watch the OGs of Desi Hip Hop - Badshah, Raftaar and Ikka - get together on the same stage, first time ever, to kick start a new phase of Hustle Season 4.

episodes.title: Bow down to the Rap Royalty
episodes.overview: It's now time to either go big or go home! Only the ones willing to risk and push their limits will cross this milestone, to be crowned the Rap Royalty of Hustle 4.

episodes.title: Raja Kumari and Power Moves
episodes.overview: This week the Hustlers bring their unique power moves to the stage to impress the Rap Queen herself, Raja Kumari!

episodes.title: Direct to Finale
episodes.overview: Watch the episode to find out which Hustler gets crowned the first Rap Royalty of the season, giving them the advantage to glide straight to the Finale!

episodes.title: Make way for Naezy The Baa
episodes.overview: It’s collaboration week on Hustle with Naezy The Baa bringing his raw energy to the stage. Watch the episode to experience some unique concepts and fresh bangers with twice the punch!

episodes.title: Riar Saab and Sambata in the hood
episodes.overview: Continuing the theme of collaboration, Riar Saab and Sambata make a surprise visit as our Hustlers get ready to battle it out for their spot in the finale. Watch the episode to find out who becomes Rap Royalty and who gets eliminated.

episodes.title: The Ultimate BattleVerse
episodes.overview: We already got 2 Rap Royalties, now there’s space for just 4 more! Watch the episode to find out who makes it through this Ultimate BattleVerse to make their spot in the finale.

episodes.title: The Final Showcase
episodes.overview: Presenting MTV Hustle 4’s 6 Finalists! Watch the episode to see our Rap Royalties drop their hardest bars and best bangers one last time before the finale.

episodes.title: The Grand Finale
episodes.overview: The wait is almost over! Our top 6 finalists perform one last time before the winner announcement, and making this moment even special is the presence of the iconic Sunidhi Chauhan.

episodes.title: MTV Hustle 4 Winner!
episodes.overview: The stage has seen it all - hard hitting bars, crazy bangers and a personal journey that will add on to the legacy of MTV Hustle 4, because Hip Hop Don’t Stop.

seasons.name: Hustle 5 - Apna Homeground
seasons.overview:
MTV India is turning the heat all the way up with MTV Hustle 5, the country’s most influential rap and hip-hop reality show. Building on the overwhelming popularity of previous seasons, the fifth edition introduces an explosive blend of underground authenticity and mainstream spectacle.

Bringing together new-school lyricists, street rappers, and viral performers, Hustle 5 showcases how Indian hip-hop is no longer an underground movement—it’s now a cultural powerhouse.

episodes.title: Back on Apna Homeground
episodes.overview: Aspiring rappers face off in a battle of beats and bars to become India's next rap star in this hip-hop reality competition.

episodes.title: The Flood of Emotions Take Over!
Let the hustle begin!
episodes.overview: From the hoods of L.A to the gullies of Mumbai, rap has become the voice of the voiceless and a symbol of living your dreams. Join Raftaar, Raja Kumari and Nucleya in the making of history as 40 aspiring emcees try their best to be the country's latest hip-hop icon. Killer bars, dope beats and a hustler's attitude, catch it all and more.

episodes.title: Naezy in awe of an O.G!
episodes.overview: Even before he drops his first bar, Raftaar cannot help but praise Hemant Dhyani, not just for his musical skills but also for his efforts in making hip-hop accessible to the underprivileged and for raising the country's next round of O.Gs through the Dharavi Project.

episodes.title: A gala at Hustle!
episodes.overview: Raja Kumari kickstarts Hustle with a bang by delivering a fantastic performance of her song 'Meera". The brilliant contestants set the stage on fire with melody, dance and lyrical masterpieces too. Watch this enthralling episode to see the names of the top 15 drop.

episodes.title: An MCs inspiring lyrical spectacle!
episodes.overview: As some of the most talented rappers spit their best verses, EPR arrives onstage and delivers a strong message through his heart-wrenching rap about suicide prevention and nearly moves Nucleya to tears. Tune in to witness EPR's sensational performance along with the judges' reactions and more.

episodes.title: Salim Merchant joins the hustlers!
episodes.overview: After a powerful and thought-provoking performance by EPR that has the judges and the audience on their feet, Salim Merchant cannot help but join him on stage to add a new twist to his lyrics and delivery style. And what follows might go down as the best performance on Hustle's stage to date. Watch their stunning performance among many others.

episodes.title: MZ Bella impresses Raftaar!
episodes.overview: The popular Indian rapper, Raga, slays the stage with his thought-provoking rap and energetic performance. Raga then clears the air with MZ Bella regarding a beef they previously had and MZ Bella leaves both Raga and Raftaar impressed with his inspiring rap performance!

episodes.title: Oh no! A blunder by Shetty Saa!
episodes.overview: It's time to bring the A game for the Hustlers as they are about to go head to head against their fellow contestants. But all this pressure to perform has a negative impact on Shetty Saa, and he forgets his lyrics midway through his performance. Will he be able to bounce back? Or is this the end to his journey?

episodes.title: Akshay and Lakshya in trouble!
episodes.overview: Lakshya Bhardwaj and Akshay Kumar get on Raftaar's bad side after their face-off goes terribly wrong. Raftaar furiously tears the lyric sheet as he reminds the two contestants that this show is not a joke. Will this incident risk their future in the competition?

episodes.title: Agsy sheds light on child abuse!
episodes.overview: Agsy sheds light on child abuse through her exquisite lyrics which brings tears to Raja Kumari. The entire crowd, contestants, and the remaining judges are touched by her expression.

episodes.title: Naezy lauds inspiring Raeza!
episodes.overview: Raeza kills the stage with her beautiful rendition towards her fellow rappers, namely EPR, Shetty Saa, and MC Heam. Being one of the youngest contestants, Raeza credits her fellow rappers for motivating her with the confidence to deliver the rap she wants to convey. All the contestants have a group hug after her performance bringing Raeza to tears of joy.

episodes.title: Brodha V in awe of RCR!
episodes.overview: Brodha V, a renowned rapper and lyricist, is here to soak in the Hustle experience. In the previous weeks, RCR delivered some emotionally charged rap performances. In contrast, he owns the stage tonight with his swagger and impresses the judges with his extremely catchy made-for-radio song. Brodha V is in awe of RCR's performance and confesses that he would listen to this song in his car on a daily basis.

episodes.title: EPR spits fire against acid!
episodes.overview: Brodha V and Raftaar kick-start the show with a powerful performance that has the audience mesmerised and wanting more. And EPR gives them what they want, with a powerful performance that pays tribute to acid attack survivors and the courage of souls like Laxmi Agarwal.

episodes.title: Shekhar to King: Please sing again!
episodes.overview: Famed Bollywood music director, Shekhar Ravjiani hits the Hustle stage to see what the competition has to offer. He is left astounded with King Rocco's performance so much that he requests him to sing again. The crowd goes wild as King manages to deliver an extravagant ensemble back to back. Tune in to this exciting episode, now on Voot!

episodes.title: All praises for Himan!
episodes.overview: Despite forgetting his lines, Himan receives high commendation from the judges for being in sync with the rap flow. Shekhar Ravjiani is so impressed with Himan's lyrics that he invites him to write for his production. Adding to Himan's happiness, Nucleya also wishes to collaborate with him after the show. Watch his amazing performance and more, now on Voot!

episodes.title: King's rule prevails!
episodes.overview: Being an avid fan of King, guest Bobby Friction calls him out to be the first performer of the night. Well, King does not disappoint! He drops a show-stopping performance that has the judges and the audience on their feet swaying to his rhythm. Watch King open with a stunner followed by other great performances and a dazzling opener from L-Fresh the Lion and MC Mirrah in this episode.

episodes.title: Tribute to a soldier's wife!
episodes.overview: Shloka is back with a bang and has the Hustle house wrapped in strong patriotic vibe with his ode to the brave wives of the soldiers. Touching on their suspenseful life and how she becomes part of the soldier's sacrifice for the country, experience the rollercoaster of emotions in this epic rap tribute, now on Voot!

episodes.title: Fotty Seven's rap jugalbandi!
episodes.overview: Fotty Seven opens the semi-finals with a spectacular performance and captivates the crowd. Being a massive representative of the underground rap scene, Fotty joins M-Zee Bella in a collaborative performance which takes rap to a whole new level. Tune in to this exciting episode, now on Voot!

episodes.title: Fight for the finale!
episodes.overview: King, RCR, Void, and Agsy have all their cards on the table as they fight for the last seat in the finals. All the hard work, dedication and patience has come down to this final moment that will decide their fates. Who will join EPR, M Zee Bella, and Shloka in the finale?

episodes.title: Grand finale is here!
episodes.overview: As the highly-anticipated grand finale knocks the door of MTV Hustle, the energy and excitement reaches a record breaking height with the performances by L Fresh the Lion and MC Mirrah! The contestants keep the musical spirits high with their spectacular rap as they try to gain an upper hand. Watch the first part of supremely entertaining grand finale.

episodes.title: Grand Finale: Who is the ultimate hustler?
episodes.overview: After a Hustle of three quick months and even quicker raps, it is finally the time to choose the ultimate hustler in the Grand Finale. EPR and M-Zee Bella, the two hustlers who made their way to the grand finale battle it out to win the coveted crown. But who will be crowned as the winner of the first-ever Hustle rap battle?

items.title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
items.overview: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.
items.description: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Kang Pi-o is known around school as an unrivaled talent — until he meets the mysterious Choi Jeong-yo and realizes he may have finally met his match.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: With Jeong-yo now his classmate, a bitter Pi-o keeps his distance. But when the two are tasked with a joint performance, Pi-o finds himself warming up.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: When crisis strikes right before the joint stage, Pi-o improvises a fix — only to wonder if it was a mistake when Jeong-yo's skills outshine his own.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: With Pi-o determined to reclaim his love for music, Jeong-yo shows Pi-o how to have fun on the piano. Jeong-yo's family troubles catch up to him.

items.title: The Legend of the Blue Sea
items.overview: A mermaid from the Joseon period ends up in present-day Seoul, where she crosses paths with a swindler who may have ties to someone from her past.
items.description: A mermaid from the Joseon period ends up in present-day Seoul, where she crosses paths with a swindler who may have ties to someone from her past.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: How can a mermaid from the Joseon era survive in modern society? Sim Chung is a mermaid who follows her one true love, a nobleman’s son named Kim Dam-Ryung from the Joseon Dynasty, to modern-day Seoul. Dam-Ryung’s modern doppelgänger is Heo Joon-Jae, a highly skilled scam artist who first becomes interested in Sim Chung because of a jade bracelet worth $6 million that Sim Chung wears. With nowhere to go, Sim Chung is taken in by Joon-Jae, who also finds his con partners, Jo Nam-Doo and Tae-O, hiding out in his home from a vengeful past victim of their scams. Sim Chung discovers a rival for Joon-Jae’s heart in Cha Si-A, a researcher at KAIST who deals with ancient artifacts. When a dangerous killer named Ma Dae-Young, sent by Joon-Jae’s stepmother who wants to make her own son the heir to Joon-Jae’s fortunes, can Sim Chung survive her strange new environment while also helping Joon-Jae avoid the dangers that await him?

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: In 1958, the nobleman Dam-Ryung releases a mermaid back into the ocean. In present-day Seoul, the figure of conman Joon-Jae stands on the same spot.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Joon-Jae brings a beautiful woman back to his hotel, unaware that she's a mermaid. Jin-Ok realizes she's been scammed and sends men after Joon-Jae.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: With no memory, Joon-Jae finds himself alone on a beach next to a jade bracelet and a single pearl. Meanwhile, the mermaid crosses the ocean to Seoul.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: At the aquarium, Joon-Jae runs into a woman being chased by security. Feeling a sense of déjà vu, Joon-Jae rescues her and brings her home.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Joon-Jae lives with the woman who he names Sim Chung. Fugitive Dae-Young has been on the run for 3 months when a murder occurs near Joon-Jae's house.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Sim Chung is involved in a traffic accident. Joon-Jae rushes to the hospital to find her in critical condition.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Joon-Jae tells Sim Chung he loves her. Meanwhile, detective Hong comes across Dae-Young while investigating a murder.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Jung-Hoon teaches Sim Chung that jealousy is the way to a man's heart. Meanwhile, Joon-Jae sees an image of a man with a mermaid on an ancient vase.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Joon-Jae finally faces off with his pursuer Dae-Young. He suffers a major injury and confesses his feelings to Sim Chung before losing consciousness.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.overview: In a museum, Joon-Jae sees a figure in a painting that looks just like him. Unable to identify the figure as Dam-Ryung, he grows distraught.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Sim Chung leaves the house after learning Joon-Jae is a conman. In a panic, Joon-Jae desperately searches for her.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Joon-Jae is arrested by detective Hong. When Sim Chung realizes they are in danger, she tracks them down.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Joon-Jae is still having strange dreams. Sim Chung hears Joon-Jae say the name Se-Hwa in his sleep. She asks him who he is talking about.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.overview: With Professor Jin's help, Joon-Jae learns he is an ancestor of Dam-Ryung. To avoid a tragic fate, he decides to protect Sim Chung whatever it takes.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Sim Chung's heart will stop without Joon-Jae's love. Upon learning this, Joon-Jae talks about his dreams and finding out that Sim Chung is a mermaid.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Joon-Jae and Yoo-Ran have an emotional reunion at Sim Chung's birthday party. Joon-Jae learns why Dae-Young has been chasing him.

episodes.title: Episode 17
episodes.overview: After almost being caught by Dae-Young, Sim Chung erases his memory. In the process, she witnesses the final moments of Dam-Ryung and Se-Hwa.

episodes.title: Episode 18
episodes.overview: After Il-Joong's death, detective Hong gets a warrant to search Seo-Hee for evidence. Meanwhile, Chi-Hyun threatens Nam-Doo to get him to cooperate.

episodes.title: Episode 19
episodes.overview: Chi-Hyun points a gun at Joon-Jae, but Sim Chung jumps in front and is shot. She slips into a coma, causing Joon-Jae to fall into despair.

episodes.title: Final
episodes.overview: Sim Chung erases Joon-Jae's memory and returns to the ocean. When Joon-Jae wakes up, there's only a single pearl next to him. Three years pass...

items.overview: When a student unearths the truth behind his grandfather’s life, he must unveil his secret superpowers to an underworld eager for his emergence.
items.description: When a student unearths the truth behind his grandfather’s life, he must unveil his secret superpowers to an underworld eager for his emergence.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Zhang Chulan’s ordinary life is upended when his grandfather’s body vanishes, drawing him into the secretive world of Outsiders. Joined by the mysterious Feng Baobao, he uncovers hidden truths about his family and powers. As they face dangerous challenges, Zhang Chulan and his companions forge bonds and seek justice while a greater battle between good and evil looms.

seasons.name: The Showdown Between Yin & Yang
seasons.overview: Zhang Chulan is thrust into the mysterious world of the Outsiders, where he faces trials that shape his journey toward heroism. Alongside Feng Baobao, whose loyalty is tested during a crisis, he uncovers secrets tied to the enigmatic Biyou Village and the legendary "Eight Supremes." Meanwhile, elite operatives of NDT Express unite to track a rogue agent, uncovering hidden truths along the way.

items.title: Reacher
items.overview: Jack Reacher, a veteran military police investigator, has just recently entered civilian life. Reacher is a drifter, carrying no phone and the barest of essentials as he travels the country and explores the nation he once served.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Based on "Killing Floor," when retired Military Police Officer Jack Reacher is arrested for a murder he did not commit, he finds himself in the middle of a deadly conspiracy full of dirty cops, shady businessmen and scheming politicians. With nothing but his wits, he must figure out what is happening in Margrave, Georgia.

episodes.title: Welcome to Margrave
episodes.overview: Reacher is wrongly accused of murder while visiting the small town of Margrave, GA.

episodes.title: First Dance
episodes.overview: When more victims are discovered, Reacher attempts to get answers but is set up. Roscoe receives a threatening message.

episodes.title: Spoonful
episodes.overview: Reacher and Finlay’s investigation into the missing Spivey leads them into a confrontation with Kliner Sr. Roscoe learns unsettling news about Reacher.

episodes.title: In a Tree
episodes.overview: As the danger increases, Reacher and Roscoe grow closer and they make plans to meet with their contact from Homeland Security.

episodes.title: No Apologies
episodes.overview: As the mystery deepens, Reacher teams up with an old colleague and Finlay makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Papier
episodes.overview: As the town is rocked by another murder, Reacher heads to New York and learns the truth about the illegal business in Margrave while Roscoe faces danger in the woods.

episodes.title: Reacher Said Nothing
episodes.overview: Reacher springs a trap and then gets trapped himself.

episodes.title: Pie
episodes.overview: Reacher leads a rescue mission at the warehouse that ends in a showdown.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Based on "Bad Luck and Trouble," when members of Reacher's old military unit start turning up dead, Reacher has just one thing on his mind—revenge.

episodes.title: ATM
episodes.overview: Reacher and Neagley investigate the murder of a member of 110th, a group of Special investigators assembled by Reacher, only to realize the whole unit may be at risk.

episodes.title: What Happens in Atlantic City
episodes.overview: The investigation into Franz's murder takes Reacher and the surviving members of his former Army unit to Atlantic City where the mystery deepens, danger awaits, and an old flame is rekindled.

episodes.title: Picture Says a Thousand Words
episodes.overview: After more of his friends fall victim, Reacher forges an uneasy alliance with a dogged detective, and their only clue in the case leads the 110th to a troubling discovery.

episodes.title: A Night at the Symphony
episodes.overview: Reacher and his team head to Boston to track down a political aide with insider knowledge of a top secret military-defense contract that may be the reason behind their friends' deaths.

episodes.title: Burial
episodes.overview: Neagley and Dixon discover shocking information about an old friend in Denver while Reacher and O'Donnell learn more about the nefarious and mysterious A.M..

episodes.title: New York's Finest
episodes.overview: As the mystery continues to unfold, Reacher and his team set a trap to even the score.

episodes.title: The Man Goes Through
episodes.overview: As the team close in on Langston, two members of the 110th face danger, compelling Reacher to devise a dangerous plan to rescue them.

episodes.title: Fly Boy
episodes.overview: Reacher and Neagley make a final desperate attempt to save O’Donnell and Dixon, stop A.M. and avenge their friends’ murder.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Based on "Persuader," Reacher hurtles into the dark heart of a vast criminal enterprise when trying to rescue an undercover DEA informant whose time is running out. There he finds a world of secrecy and violence—and confronts some unfinished business from his own past.

episodes.title: Persuader
episodes.overview: Reacher's attempt to thwart a kidnapping brings him into contact with mysterious businessman Zachary Beck.

episodes.title: Truckin'
episodes.overview: Tasked with transporting cargo for his new employer Zachary Beck, Reacher must juggle the involvement of the DEA and a nosy new associate.

episodes.title: Number 2 with a Bullet
episodes.overview: As a rising body count threatens his undercover position, Reacher makes a dangerous play to secure Beck's trust.

episodes.title: Dominique
episodes.overview: Reacher reunites with Duffy and Villanueva and finally shares the painful details of his history with Xavier Quinn.

episodes.title: Smackdown
episodes.overview: When a DEA tragedy puts the entire mission at risk, Reacher, Duffy, and Villanueva improvise a drastic plan to save their cover.

episodes.title: Smoke on the Water
episodes.overview: Reacher is torn between his desire to kill Quinn and his promise to Duffy to save Teresa.

episodes.title: L.A. Story
episodes.overview: After Reacher and Duffy travel to Los Angeles to arrange a deal, Neagley arrives in Maine to help Reacher get answers.

episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.overview: Reacher finally faces off with both Paulie and Quinn.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Based on "Gone Tomorrow," when a chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a subway goes horribly wrong, Jack Reacher is drawn into a complex and deadly game that pits him against ruthless foes from the highest echelons of power.

episodes.title: City of Brotherly Love
episodes.overview: A chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a Philadelphia subway car draws Jack Reacher into a deadly mystery involving a missing flash drive that contains secrets worth killing for.

episodes.title: Cage Fight
episodes.overview: Tamara finds herself caught up in the mystery whether she likes it or not as she, Reacher, and Jacob face off against shady government agents and a mysterious squad of professional soldiers all looking for the same missing flash drive.

episodes.title: One Small Step
episodes.overview: Reacher learns that things are more complex than they seem as he and Lila draw closer. Meanwhile, Tamara, Jacob, and Plum find an important clue after another attack from one of their mysterious adversaries sends them back to Philadelphia.

episodes.title: Karambits and Pieces
episodes.overview: Reacher interrogates Sampson, Tamara breaks into a government facility, Jacob receives some crushing news and the team learns a piece of information that changes everything.

episodes.title: Bridge
episodes.overview: After a misunderstanding, Reacher becomes Philadelphia's Most Wanted. Meanwhile, old enemies catch up with him and new ones emerge. Jacob, Tamara and Plum end up in a firefight, giving Jacob his first real shot at avenging his sister's death.

episodes.title: Plum Out of Luck
episodes.overview: Fleeing the police, Reacher and Tamara head out-of-town to find the mysterious Ahlquist only to run into more trouble. Meanwhile, Jacob and Plum deal with their own problems back in Philadelphia.

episodes.title: Vote for Sampson
episodes.overview: Reacher and Tamara finally get the answers they've been looking for. Meanwhile, Jacob learns that their problems are just beginning when Plum's sources come through with some timely information.

episodes.title: Cut
episodes.overview: Reacher, Tamara and Jacob take the fight to the enemy as the full extent of their plot is revealed. Reacher faces off with those responsible for Anna's death while Jacob faces a moment of truth and Plum gets his shot at redemption.
