items.title: Resort
items.overview: A debt-ridden room service boy rises to challenge a ruthless kitchen at a luxurious beachside haven.
items.description: A debt-ridden room service boy rises to challenge a ruthless kitchen at a luxurious beachside haven.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A 12th-fail room service boy rises to challenge a ruthless kitchen at a luxurious beachside haven.

episodes.title: Hell's Kitchen
episodes.overview: Vetri is a village boy burdened by his family responsibilities. His journey begins at RR Resort, where he comes face-to-face with Nedumaran, the resort kitchen's dictator.

episodes.title: Unwitting Actions
episodes.overview: Pandi guides Vetri through the resort to familiarise him with how things work there. Later, Aishu is harshly punished by Nedumaran because of Vetri's careless mistake.

episodes.title: The Lid is Lifted
episodes.overview: Vetri gets an opportunity to earn a living with his cooking. He comes across Nedumaran's signature soup. Meanwhile, an influencer couple raises a ruckus in the resort.

episodes.title: Doomed
episodes.overview: Nedumaran is enraged when Rajan speaks about cost-cutting. Vetri further aggravates his mood by selling his soup recipe from a street cart. Will Vetri survive Nedumaran's wrath?

episodes.title: Be Irreplaceable
episodes.overview: Nedumaran fumes as an inexperienced Vetri cracks his signature dish recipe. His plea to join the kitchen team is denied. Joji enjoys Vetri's Rasam rice. A prank on Aishu backfires.

episodes.title: Behind the Mask
episodes.overview: Joji tells Vetri that his Rasam rice reminded him of his college love. Aishu tries to sabotage Vetri's service by changing the dishes. Vetri finds out about Aishu's secret life.

episodes.title: Wave of Nostalgia
episodes.overview: Vetri plays cupid for Joji. Vetri's effort to make peace with Aishu fails. Aishu panics when she learns that Vetri is aware of her masked secret. Riya tries to patch up with Aishu.

episodes.title: Ghost from the Past
episodes.overview: Vetri helps Aishu and Veni with his cooking skills. Furious at first, Nedumaran is surprised when he tastes Vetri's dish. Later, he is shocked to learn who Vetri's father is.

episodes.title: Frozen in Fear
episodes.overview: Foreign guests like Vetri's dish, and he gets considered for the kitchen team. However, this opportunity rattles others in the kitchen.

episodes.title: Opportunity or Adversity?
episodes.overview: Nedumaran's decision about Vetri's entry into the kitchen shocks everyone. Will Vetri be up for the challenge?

episodes.title: Gearing Up
episodes.overview: Riya checks into the resort to comfort herself. Meanwhile, among gifts and sleeplessness, Vetri eagerly anticipates his big day in the kitchen.

episodes.title: Lifeblood of the Kitchen
episodes.overview: All prepared, Vetri delegates the day's menu to the kitchen staff. However, the new chef faces many struggles, the worst being the interruption of gas supply.

episodes.title: Sense of Schadenfreude
episodes.overview: Vetri rises to the challenge by using firewood stove and wins praises for the lunch menu. Seeing the kitchen's condition, Nedumaran throws Vetri out and is happy about his failure.

episodes.title: Fresh Ally
episodes.overview: Vetri's special Biryani request from the guests is rejected. Aishu stands up for Vetri when Vicky mocks him. She makes an appeal when Vetri and Pandi visit the bar where she sings.

episodes.title: Comeuppance
episodes.overview: The room service team gets targeted by the kitchen team after Vetri's failure. While Nedumaran announces Aishu as the new Sous Chef, he punishes Vicky for his reckless behaviour.

episodes.title: Covetous Desire
episodes.overview: Veni confronts Aishu for going against Vicky. Nedumaran feigns joy when Ragupathi informs him about handing over the resort to Riya. Deepak's announcement at the party shocks Riya.

episodes.title: The Good Girl Syndrome
episodes.overview: Ragupathi watches Riya being tortured by Deepak. Vetri and Aishu cook a special dish for Joji's date with his lady love. Aishu tries to tell her dad about her passion for singing.

episodes.title: Emotional Armour
episodes.overview: Ragupathi assures Riya of his support. Veni feels bad for Vicky who is frustrated with his room service job. Joji and Padma's date is ruined by Padma's daughter.

episodes.title: Seething Anger
episodes.overview: Nedumaran is angry as Ragupathi's request was actually Vetri's recipe. Joji bids adieu to Padma with a heavy heart. Vetri attends Nedumaran's call for Aishu by mistake.

episodes.title: Face from the Past
episodes.overview: Riya decides to continue staying at the resort. Rajan sorts an issue when John tries to blow it up. Nedumaran pretends not to recall Chidambaram when an old friend asks about him.

episodes.title: Close Confidante
episodes.overview: Aishu spots Veni and Vicky having an argument and feels betrayed. Though Rajan warns Riya, she tries to talk to Nedumaran about the food expenditure.

episodes.title: Secret Kitchen
episodes.overview: Vetri and Pandi hunt for a place and an investor to start their new business. Aishu tries talking to Vicky about Veni, which ends in disaster.

episodes.title: Drifting Apart
episodes.overview: Uthaman intervenes when Vetri and Vicky get into an intense argument. At Siva's birthday party, Veni sees Srinidhi and Vicky together, and she gets upset and drunk.

episodes.title: Where is Chika?
episodes.overview: Riya talks to Rajan about the resort's major problem: food. Vetri's dish from his secret kitchen gets mistakenly delivered to the wrong guest. Will Vetri get caught?

episodes.title: Lovelorn Veni
episodes.overview: Nedumaran ruins Riya's attempt to change things in the resort. Back in the kitchen team, Vicky breaks up with Veni. Vetri and Aishu save Veni when she tries to end her life.

episodes.title: Delving into the Past
episodes.overview: Leo's words remind Ragupathi of Chika and he decides to locate him. Nedumaran humiliates Aishu after seeing her with Vetri. Aishu learns about Vetri’s father and his family's past.

episodes.title: The Supercilious Chef
episodes.overview: When Vicky questions Nedumaran for making Aishu the Sous Chef, a cooking challenge is held between them. Ragupathi’s decision to find the truth about Chidambaram upsets Nedumaran.

episodes.title: Resurfacing of Memories
episodes.overview: Aishu takes Vetri's mom and sister to her house for a day and is shocked to see Nedumaran back early from his travel. What happens when he learns the truth about their background?

episodes.title: New Ideas
episodes.overview: Vetri gives his mom a tour of the resort. Riya shares her business plan with Ragupathi. While Vetri helps Aishu with the sous chef test, Nedumaran warns her to stay away from him.

episodes.title: Dinner or Date?
episodes.overview: Aishu tells Vetri that her father knows about the guests. She invites Vetri out for dinner. Nedumaran is not happy when Ragupathi tells him about Riya's new business plan.

episodes.title: Chefs' Cook-Off
episodes.overview: Nedumaran announces three rounds of the sous chef cook-off. While he demands that Aishu win the challenge, Vicky tries to distract her. Later, Nedumaran accepts the business idea.

episodes.title: The Clock Is Ticking
episodes.overview: Vetri boosts Aishu when Vicky mocks her for losing. Aishu wins the next round. She recalls Vetri’s words as she panics in the third round. Ragupathi gets a call about Chidambaram.

episodes.title: The Shindig
episodes.overview: Nedumaran resents Aishu's friendship with Vetri. Ragupathy leaves to find Chidambaram. Joji is miffed when no one remembers his birthday, but Vetri has a solution.

episodes.title: The Apologetic Attacker
episodes.overview: John tries to target Vetri to appease Nedumaran by messing up a guest's order. Vicky attends his friend's bachelor party and finds Vetri taking their 'special' food order.

episodes.title: Native Charm
episodes.overview: Vetri is tasked with handling an inspection officer, who comes over to thoroughly check the resort. Vicky and Srinidhi decide to investigate what Vetri and Pandi are up to.

episodes.title: Busted
episodes.overview: After Nedumaran warns him, Vetri avoids Aishu, leaving her upset and confused. When Aishu discovers Vetri in his secret kitchen, she leaves without listening to his explanation.

episodes.title: Smoking Gun
episodes.overview: Vetri is caught red-handed and faces Nedumaran’s wrath after Vicky shares video evidence of his secret kitchen. Vicky lies that Aishu took the video. Ragupathi visits Vetri's mom.

episodes.title: Disillusioned
episodes.overview: Aishu confronts Vicky for his heinous move. Defying a furious Nedumaran, Ragupathi handles the situation and Vetri is released from the station. Aishu tries to speak to Vetri.

episodes.title: Penitent Vetri
episodes.overview: Vetri's suspension surprises everyone. While Ragupathi accepts Vetri's heartfelt apology, his decision upsets Nedumaran. Vetri is glad to see Bhavani’s food cart back in business.

episodes.title: Stonewalling
episodes.overview: Riya launches RR Resort Masala Products. Nedumaran is shocked that Ragupathi knows Vetri's father and is looking for him. Aishu is hurt as Vetri decides to stay away from her.

episodes.title: Dissolved in Tears
episodes.overview: Aishu feels guilty about Vetri. Joji advices Vetri to save his friendship. Rajan shares vital news with Ragupathi about Chidambaram. Aishu has a heartfelt talk with Nedumaran.

episodes.title: Mea Culpa
episodes.overview: Ragupathi learns that Chidambaram is innocent. Meanwhile, Vicky's mother makes an unexpected visit to the resort and advises him to value his friendships.

episodes.title: Food Fest'26
episodes.overview: Vetri helps Ramya at her college food festival and is shocked by the chief guest. Vicky apologises to Aishu and tries to fix things with Veni, but things do not go as planned.

episodes.title: Languishing in Prison!
episodes.overview: Vetri rejoins his duty at the resort and promises Ragupathi to be loyal always. While Ragupathi is desperately looking for Chidambaram, what big secret is Nedumaran hiding?

episodes.title: Flopped Business
episodes.overview: Riya is upset as her business plan fails. Nedumaran rebukes Riya and Rajan when they inform him about the food’s quality at the resort. Vetri decides to talk to Shibu for Aishu.

episodes.title: Nudging Friends
episodes.overview: Ragupathi asks Riya to take up the pantry project with Vetri to help her. Nedumaran praises Aishu for running the kitchen smoothly. Vetri makes Shibu listen to Aishu’s rendition.

episodes.title: Renewed Opportunity
episodes.overview: Nedumaran gets angry that Vetri is to manage the pantry and questions Ragupathi. Shibu promises an opportunity for Aishu to Vetri. After Vicky apologises, Veni reconciles with him.

episodes.title: Renaissance
episodes.overview: Vetri sets up the pantry and is happy to know of a salary hike. While Aishu is ready to sacrifice her dreams for her father's happiness, Nedumaran learns about her secret identity.

episodes.title: Filial Betrayal
episodes.overview: Things take a turn when Nedumaran discovers Aishu's hidden identity. Tensions escalate within the Pantry team as they face new challenges and conflicts.

episodes.title: Immolating Dreams
episodes.overview: Aishu rejects Shibu's offer and assures Nedumaran she won't betray him like her sister. Priya hints at a plan to her brother, who warns her to be cautious.

episodes.title: Culinary Stage
episodes.overview: Ramya joins Nedumaran's kitchen as a trainee. Vetri's pantry sale picks up, but Riya rebukes him for not following the assigned menu. Vetri scolds Ramya for confronting Aishu.

episodes.title: Entrapped
episodes.overview: After Rajan advices Riya, she asks Vetri to make some dishes for the pantry. While Bhavani waits for Ramya to return, Priya traps her in a dangerous situation. Will Ramya survive?

episodes.title: Frantic Search
episodes.overview: Vetri and Pandi scour the resort in search of Ramya. Priya worriedly calls her brother and tells him about her mistake. Once the rescue is dealt with, Vetri goes on a field trip.

episodes.title: A Daughter's Atonement
episodes.overview: Aishu upsets everyone with her tyrannical behaviour. Veni spots Priya snooping around and gets suspicious. Vetri has a new menu. Will he successfully implement it?

episodes.title: Contrasting Sisters
episodes.overview: Divya asks for Riya's support at her wedding. Aishu tells Divya that she will not let their father down. Aishu warns Vicky for mocking Ramya. Vetri is sad as the pantry sales drop.

episodes.title: Bitter Encounters
episodes.overview: Vetri's new menu struggles to attract customers. Ramya tells Vetri about how Vicky bullies her, which angers him. Divya finally comes face to face with Nedumaran at the resort.

episodes.title: Aishu's Complaint
episodes.overview: After a complaint from Aishu reaches Rajan, Vetri faces an uncomfortable meeting. Feeling dejected, he finds support from Ramya and Pandi, who motivate him to focus on the pantry.

episodes.title: Suspicions Sparked
episodes.overview: Nedumaran brushes aside Aishu's wedding-related concerns, while Vetri finds inspiration for new pantry dishes. Veni grows suspicious of Priya's actions and shares it with Vicky.

episodes.title: Yearning Daughters
episodes.overview: Vetri works tirelessly to manage both the pantry and room service while launching fresh ideas. Meanwhile, Nedumaran's anger flares when he learns of Divya's wedding menu plans.

episodes.title: Booming Pantry Sales
episodes.overview: Ragupathi shares his concern about Chidambaram with Nedumaran. Vetri makes a sweet for Divya. Vetri's strategy with kids works well for the pantry business, making Nedumaran angry.

episodes.title: Showered by Appreciation
episodes.overview: Nedumaran fumes as the pantry food is liked by the guests. While Riya congratulates Vetri, Ragupathi praises her for the pantry's success. Nedumaran recalls his talk with Chika.

episodes.title: Spurned Invitation
episodes.overview: Nedumaran lashes at Divya for inviting him to her wedding. John announces the Star Chef competition. Priya plans her revenge by tarnishing Nedumaran's name at Divya's wedding.

episodes.title: Wrecking the Wedding
episodes.overview: Nedumaran's new signature dish becomes an instant hit. He ignores Karthik who tries to convince him to attend the wedding. Priya executes her plan amidst the wedding preparations.

episodes.title: Blood is Thicker than Water
episodes.overview: Priya's plan fails as Nedumaran handles the situation. Divya is elated to see her father at her wedding as Aishu gives him an earful. Nedumaran rages when Aishu shows him a photo.

episodes.title: A Bride's Farewell
episodes.overview: Nedumaran has a private word with Karthik before bidding the newlyweds goodbye. Uthaman introduces the new members to the room service team. Meanwhile, Vetri falls sick.

episodes.title: The Hidden Truth

episodes.overview: The situation at the resort worsens when board members pull back. When the employees begin to fear for their jobs, Ragupathi calls for a staff meeting.

episodes.overview: Durai sees Chidambaram in Vetri and tells him about how he knew his father and his tragic past. When Veni calls Aishu to vent her frustration, the latter learns a startling truth.

episodes.title: Good Luck
episodes.overview: Just when Vetri completes his training, he gets a call from his sister that his mother is hospitalised. On the day of the competition, Nedumaran warns the organiser about Vetri.

episodes.title: The Champion Returns
episodes.overview: When Vetri goes to register for the competition, they question the legitimacy of Durai's signature. However, all hope is not lost.

episodes.title: Chef's Culinary Clash Begins
episodes.overview: Durai wishes Vetri and leaves. Aishu confronts Selvin for hiding about partaking in the competition. Nedumaran briefs Aishu. Meanwhile, will Vetri be able to handle the rounds?

episodes.title: Memory of a Father
episodes.overview: Vetri freezes before the first round. Later, he recalls his childhood memories with his father and that inspires him to make his first dish of the competition.

episodes.title: The Sous Chefs
episodes.overview: In the new round, Veni becomes Vetri's sous chef and Vicky becomes Aishu's. Veni's presence distracts Vicky, who misses her a lot.

episodes.title: A Friend in Need
episodes.overview: Selvin wins an advantage and chooses a toughest ingredient to break his opponents. Durai's training helps Vetri, but he uses his time to help Aishu. Selvin’s query confuses Vetri.

episodes.title: A Helpless Son
episodes.overview: Aishu asks Nedumaran why he's so hell-bent on her winning the competition. Just before the finals, Vetri receives a devastating call from his sister about his mother's condition.

episodes.title: The Final Dish
episodes.overview: While Vetri stands still, feeling helpless, a timely help from a benefactor saves the day. However, when Vetri presents his final dish, the judges get upset with his presentation.

episodes.title: The Star Chef Rises
episodes.overview: The judges and viewers are moved after Vetri shares the concept behind his dish. Once the competition ends, Aishu tells her father her wish.

episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.overview: Everyone awaits the arrival of their new CEO at RR Resort, but their identity shocks them. Vetri settles his debts and returns to the resort, but his choice surprises Ragupathi.

episodes.title: Hell's Kitchen
episodes.overview: Vetri is a village boy burdened by his family responsibilities. His journey begins at RR Resort, where he comes face-to-face with Nedumaran, the resort kitchen's dictator.

episodes.title: Unwitting Actions
episodes.overview: Pandi guides Vetri through the resort to familiarise him with how things work there. Later, Aishu is harshly punished by Nedumaran because of Vetri's careless mistake.

episodes.title: The Lid is Lifted
episodes.overview: Vetri gets an opportunity to earn a living with his cooking. He comes across Nedumaran's signature soup. Meanwhile, an influencer couple raises a ruckus in the resort.

episodes.title: Doomed
episodes.overview: Nedumaran is enraged when Rajan speaks about cost-cutting. Vetri further aggravates his mood by selling his soup recipe from a street cart. Will Vetri survive Nedumaran's wrath?

episodes.overview: Nedumaran fumes as an inexperienced Vetri cracks his signature dish recipe. His plea to join the kitchen team is denied. Joji enjoys Vetri's Rasam rice. A prank on Aishu backfires.

episodes.title: Behind the Mask

episodes.title: Wave of Nostalgia
episodes.overview: Vetri plays cupid for Joji. Vetri's effort to make peace with Aishu fails. Aishu panics when she learns that Vetri is aware of her masked secret. Riya tries to patch up with Aishu.

episodes.title: Ghost from the Past
episodes.overview: Vetri helps Aishu and Veni with his cooking skills. Furious at first, Nedumaran is surprised when he tastes Vetri's dish. Later, he is shocked to learn who Vetri's father is.

episodes.title: Frozen in Fear
episodes.overview: Foreign guests like Vetri's dish, and he gets considered for the kitchen team. However, this opportunity rattles others in the kitchen.

episodes.title: Opportunity or Adversity?
episodes.overview: Nedumaran's decision about Vetri's entry into the kitchen shocks everyone. Will Vetri be up for the challenge?

episodes.title: Gearing Up
episodes.overview: Riya checks into the resort to comfort herself. Meanwhile, among gifts and sleeplessness, Vetri eagerly anticipates his big day in the kitchen.

episodes.title: Lifeblood of the Kitchen
episodes.overview: All prepared, Vetri delegates the day's menu to the kitchen staff. However, the new chef faces many struggles, the worst being the interruption of gas supply.

episodes.title: Sense of Schadenfreude
episodes.overview: Vetri rises to the challenge by using firewood stove and wins praises for the lunch menu. Seeing the kitchen's condition, Nedumaran throws Vetri out and is happy about his failure.

episodes.title: Fresh Ally
episodes.overview: Vetri's special Biryani request from the guests is rejected. Aishu stands up for Vetri when Vicky mocks him. She makes an appeal when Vetri and Pandi visit the bar where she sings.

episodes.title: Comeuppance
episodes.overview: The room service team gets targeted by the kitchen team after Vetri's failure. While Nedumaran announces Aishu as the new Sous Chef, he punishes Vicky for his reckless behaviour.

episodes.title: Covetous Desire
episodes.overview: Veni confronts Aishu for going against Vicky. Nedumaran feigns joy when Ragupathi informs him about handing over the resort to Riya. Deepak's announcement at the party shocks Riya.

episodes.title: The Good Girl Syndrome
episodes.overview: Ragupathi watches Riya being tortured by Deepak. Vetri and Aishu cook a special dish for Joji's date with his lady love. Aishu tries to tell her dad about her passion for singing.

episodes.title: Emotional Armour
episodes.overview: Ragupathi assures Riya of his support. Veni feels bad for Vicky who is frustrated with his room service job. Joji and Padma's date is ruined by Padma's daughter.

episodes.title: Seething Anger
episodes.overview: Nedumaran is angry as Ragupathi's request was actually Vetri's recipe. Joji bids adieu to Padma with a heavy heart. Vetri attends Nedumaran's call for Aishu by mistake.

episodes.title: Face from the Past
episodes.overview: Riya decides to continue staying at the resort. Rajan sorts an issue when John tries to blow it up. Nedumaran pretends not to recall Chidambaram when an old friend asks about him.

episodes.title: Close Confidante
episodes.overview: Aishu spots Veni and Vicky having an argument and feels betrayed. Though Rajan warns Riya, she tries to talk to Nedumaran about the food expenditure.

episodes.title: Secret Kitchen
episodes.overview: Vetri and Pandi hunt for a place and an investor to start their new business. Aishu tries talking to Vicky about Veni, which ends in disaster.

episodes.title: Drifting Apart
episodes.overview: Uthaman intervenes when Vetri and Vicky get into an intense argument. At Siva's birthday party, Veni sees Srinidhi and Vicky together, and she gets upset and drunk.

episodes.title: Where is Chika?
episodes.overview: Riya talks to Rajan about the resort's major problem: food. Vetri's dish from his secret kitchen gets mistakenly delivered to the wrong guest. Will Vetri get caught?

episodes.title: Lovelorn Veni
episodes.overview: Nedumaran ruins Riya's attempt to change things in the resort. Back in the kitchen team, Vicky breaks up with Veni. Vetri and Aishu save Veni when she tries to end her life.

episodes.title: Delving into the Past

episodes.title: Resurfacing of Memories

episodes.title: New Ideas
episodes.overview: Vetri gives his mom a tour of the resort. Riya shares her business plan with Ragupathi. While Vetri helps Aishu with the sous chef test, Nedumaran warns her to stay away from him.

episodes.title: Dinner or Date?
episodes.overview: Aishu tells Vetri that her father knows about the guests. She invites Vetri out for dinner. Nedumaran is not happy when Ragupathi tells him about Riya's new business plan.

episodes.title: Chefs' Cook-Off
episodes.overview: Nedumaran announces three rounds of the sous chef cook-off. While he demands that Aishu win the challenge, Vicky tries to distract her. Later, Nedumaran accepts the business idea.

episodes.title: The Clock Is Ticking
episodes.overview: Vetri boosts Aishu when Vicky mocks her for losing. Aishu wins the next round. She recalls Vetri’s words as she panics in the third round. Ragupathi gets a call about Chidambaram.

episodes.title: The Shindig
episodes.overview: Nedumaran resents Aishu's friendship with Vetri. Ragupathy leaves to find Chidambaram. Joji is miffed when no one remembers his birthday, but Vetri has a solution.

episodes.title: The Apologetic Attacker

episodes.title: Native Charm
episodes.overview: Vetri is tasked with handling an inspection officer, who comes over to thoroughly check the resort. Vicky and Srinidhi decide to investigate what Vetri and Pandi are up to.

episodes.title: Busted
episodes.overview: After Nedumaran warns him, Vetri avoids Aishu, leaving her upset and confused. When Aishu discovers Vetri in his secret kitchen, she leaves without listening to his explanation.

episodes.title: Smoking Gun
episodes.overview: Vetri is caught red-handed and faces Nedumaran’s wrath after Vicky shares video evidence of his secret kitchen. Vicky lies that Aishu took the video. Ragupathi visits Vetri's mom.

episodes.title: Disillusioned
episodes.overview: Aishu confronts Vicky for his heinous move. Defying a furious Nedumaran, Ragupathi handles the situation and Vetri is released from the station. Aishu tries to speak to Vetri.

episodes.title: Penitent Vetri
episodes.overview: Vetri's suspension surprises everyone. While Ragupathi accepts Vetri's heartfelt apology, his decision upsets Nedumaran. Vetri is glad to see Bhavani’s food cart back in business.

episodes.title: Stonewalling
episodes.overview: Riya launches RR Resort Masala Products. Nedumaran is shocked that Ragupathi knows Vetri's father and is looking for him. Aishu is hurt as Vetri decides to stay away from her.

episodes.title: Dissolved in Tears
episodes.overview: Aishu feels guilty about Vetri. Joji advices Vetri to save his friendship. Rajan shares vital news with Ragupathi about Chidambaram. Aishu has a heartfelt talk with Nedumaran.

episodes.title: Mea Culpa
episodes.overview: Ragupathi learns that Chidambaram is innocent. Meanwhile, Vicky's mother makes an unexpected visit to the resort and advises him to value his friendships.

episodes.title: Food Fest'26
episodes.overview: Vetri helps Ramya at her college food festival and is shocked by the chief guest. Vicky apologises to Aishu and tries to fix things with Veni, but things do not go as planned.

episodes.overview: Vetri rejoins his duty at the resort and promises Ragupathi to be loyal always. While Ragupathi is desperately looking for Chidambaram, what big secret is Nedumaran hiding?

episodes.overview: Riya is upset as her business plan fails. Nedumaran rebukes Riya and Rajan when they inform him about the food’s quality at the resort. Vetri decides to talk to Shibu for Aishu.

episodes.title: Nudging Friends
episodes.overview: Ragupathi asks Riya to take up the pantry project with Vetri to help her. Nedumaran praises Aishu for running the kitchen smoothly. Vetri makes Shibu listen to Aishu’s rendition.

episodes.title: Renewed Opportunity
episodes.overview: Nedumaran gets angry that Vetri is to manage the pantry and questions Ragupathi. Shibu promises an opportunity for Aishu to Vetri. After Vicky apologises, Veni reconciles with him.

episodes.title: Renaissance
episodes.overview: Vetri sets up the pantry and is happy to know of a salary hike. While Aishu is ready to sacrifice her dreams for her father's happiness, Nedumaran learns about her secret identity.

episodes.title: Filial Betrayal
episodes.overview: Things take a turn when Nedumaran discovers Aishu's hidden identity. Tensions escalate within the Pantry team as they face new challenges and conflicts.

episodes.title: Immolating Dreams
episodes.overview: Aishu rejects Shibu's offer and assures Nedumaran she won't betray him like her sister. Priya hints at a plan to her brother, who warns her to be cautious.

episodes.title: Culinary Stage
episodes.overview: Ramya joins Nedumaran's kitchen as a trainee. Vetri's pantry sale picks up, but Riya rebukes him for not following the assigned menu. Vetri scolds Ramya for confronting Aishu.

episodes.title: Entrapped
episodes.overview: After Rajan advices Riya, she asks Vetri to make some dishes for the pantry. While Bhavani waits for Ramya to return, Priya traps her in a dangerous situation. Will Ramya survive?

episodes.title: Frantic Search
episodes.overview: Vetri and Pandi scour the resort in search of Ramya. Priya worriedly calls her brother and tells him about her mistake. Once the rescue is dealt with, Vetri goes on a field trip.

episodes.title: A Daughter's Atonement
episodes.overview: Aishu upsets everyone with her tyrannical behaviour. Veni spots Priya snooping around and gets suspicious. Vetri has a new menu. Will he successfully implement it?

episodes.title: Contrasting Sisters
episodes.overview: Divya asks for Riya's support at her wedding. Aishu tells Divya that she will not let their father down. Aishu warns Vicky for mocking Ramya. Vetri is sad as the pantry sales drop.

episodes.title: Bitter Encounters
episodes.overview: Vetri's new menu struggles to attract customers. Ramya tells Vetri about how Vicky bullies her, which angers him. Divya finally comes face to face with Nedumaran at the resort.

episodes.title: Aishu's Complaint
episodes.overview: After a complaint from Aishu reaches Rajan, Vetri faces an uncomfortable meeting. Feeling dejected, he finds support from Ramya and Pandi, who motivate him to focus on the pantry.

episodes.title: Suspicions Sparked
episodes.overview: Nedumaran brushes aside Aishu's wedding-related concerns, while Vetri finds inspiration for new pantry dishes. Veni grows suspicious of Priya's actions and shares it with Vicky.

episodes.title: Yearning Daughters
episodes.overview: Vetri works tirelessly to manage both the pantry and room service while launching fresh ideas. Meanwhile, Nedumaran's anger flares when he learns of Divya's wedding menu plans.

episodes.title: Booming Pantry Sales
episodes.overview: Ragupathi shares his concern about Chidambaram with Nedumaran. Vetri makes a sweet for Divya. Vetri's strategy with kids works well for the pantry business, making Nedumaran angry.

episodes.title: Showered by Appreciation
episodes.overview: Nedumaran fumes as the pantry food is liked by the guests. While Riya congratulates Vetri, Ragupathi praises her for the pantry's success. Nedumaran recalls his talk with Chika.

episodes.title: Spurned Invitation

episodes.title: Chef's Culinary Clash Begins
episodes.overview: Durai wishes Vetri and leaves. Aishu confronts Selvin for hiding about partaking in the competition. Nedumaran briefs Aishu. Meanwhile, will Vetri be able to handle the rounds?

episodes.title: Memory of a Father
episodes.overview: Vetri freezes before the first round. Later, he recalls his childhood memories with his father and that inspires him to make his first dish of the competition.

episodes.title: The Sous Chefs
episodes.overview: In the new round, Veni becomes Vetri's sous chef and Vicky becomes Aishu's. Veni's presence distracts Vicky, who misses her a lot.

episodes.title: A Friend in Need
episodes.overview: Selvin wins an advantage and chooses a toughest ingredient to break his opponents. Durai's training helps Vetri, but he uses his time to help Aishu. Selvin’s query confuses Vetri.

episodes.title: A Helpless Son
episodes.overview: Aishu asks Nedumaran why he's so hell-bent on her winning the competition. Just before the finals, Vetri receives a devastating call from his sister about his mother's condition.

episodes.title: The Final Dish
episodes.overview: While Vetri stands still, feeling helpless, a timely help from a benefactor saves the day. However, when Vetri presents his final dish, the judges get upset with his presentation.

episodes.title: The Star Chef Rises
episodes.overview: The judges and viewers are moved after Vetri shares the concept behind his dish. Once the competition ends, Aishu tells her father her wish.

episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.overview: Everyone awaits the arrival of their new CEO at RR Resort, but their identity shocks them. Vetri settles his debts and returns to the resort, but his choice surprises Ragupathi.

items.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
items.overview: Corporate worker Mikami Satoru is stabbed by a random killer, and is reborn to an alternate world. But he turns out to be reborn a slime! Thrown into this new world with the name Rimuru, he begins his quest to create a world that’s welcoming to all races.
items.description: Corporate worker Mikami Satoru is stabbed by a random killer, and is reborn to an alternate world. But he turns out to be reborn a slime! Thrown into this new world with the name Rimuru, he begins his quest to create a world that’s welcoming to all races.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Corporate worker Mikami Satoru is stabbed by a random killer, and is reborn to an alternate world. But he turns out to be reborn a slime! Thrown into this new world with the name Rimuru, he begins his quest to create a world that’s welcoming to all races.

episodes.title: The Storm Dragon, Veldora
episodes.overview: Mikami Satoru, a businessman, is stabbed by a criminal on the street and killed. When he regains consciousness in the darkness, he finds that he's been reincarnated as a slime! With nothing better to do, he spends his time devouring all the rare herbs and precious ores he comes across. As he does, he encounters the Storm Dragon Veldora, who was sealed in this cave 300 years ago by a hero's "Unlimited Imprisonment" skill. He's frightened at first, but as they talk, he becomes friends with the long-isolated Veldora.

episodes.title: Meeting the Goblins
episodes.overview: The slime Mikami and the Storm Dragon Veldora decide to give each other names. Veldora gives the slime Mikami the name "Rimuru," and Rimuru comes up with a family name for both of them: "Tempest." Then Rimuru uses his Predator skill to take Veldora into his body and analyze the "Unlimited Imprisonment" seal in hopes of breaking it... but this action sends a shock through the nations surrounding the Great Forest of Jura. With Veldora gone, there's a chance that the larger nations could become bold and invade the smaller provinces. With no knowledge of this, Rimuru leaves the cave and meets some Goblins.

episodes.title: Battle at the Goblin Village
episodes.overview: After leaving the cave, Rimuru encounters a village of Goblins under attack by a clan of Direwolves. Caught in the heat of the moment, Rimuru agrees to help the Goblins in their battle. That night, the Direwolves arrive to try to take over as the new rulers of the Great Forest of Jura!

episodes.title: In the Kingdom of the Dwarves
episodes.overview: Rimuru and his companions visit the Dwarven Kingdom, the Armed Nation of Dwargon, in search of some artisans to help the Goblins learn to supply their own food, shelter, and clothing. However, a skirmish just outside the city gate lands Rimuru and Gobta in a prison cell. Then there's a report of an Armorsaurus in the nearby mines!

episodes.title: Hero King, Gazel Dwargo
episodes.overview: Thanks to Rimuru's skill, Kaijin was able to finish all the longswords and deliver them to the king, so the two of them celebrate by heading to a bar staffed by lots of elf girls. One of them reads Rimuru's fortune for fun, and sees an image in her crystal ball of someone she believes Rimuru is destined to be with. As everyone wonders who this person could be, Vesta shows up and starts to hassle Rimuru...

episodes.title: Shizu
episodes.overview: One day, in the midst of the improvements on the Goblin Village with the help of Kaijin and the dwarves, Rimuru meets a trio of adventurers from the Guild who've been temporarily joined by a masked woman named Shizu. Shizu turns out to be the person Rimuru is destined to be with, as his fortune said. Shizu also came to this world from Japan, but unlike him, she was summoned here many years ago. So Rimuru uses his Thought Communication skill to show Shizu what Japan looks like today.

episodes.title: Conqueror of Flames
episodes.overview: The Demon Lord Leon Cromwell summoned Shizu out of Tokyo as it burned during in the air raids, then forced the high-ranked spirit Ifrit to possess her. After taking over Shizu's body, Ifrit begins to rampage.

episodes.title: Inherited Will
episodes.overview: When Shizu was still with Demon Lord Leon, it was a Hero who rescued her. That Hero was Shizu's inspiration to help as many people as she could for many years. She even worked as a teacher for children who'd come from other worlds. And now, as her time comes to an end, Shizu asks Rimuru for one last favor...

episodes.title: Attack of the Ogres
episodes.overview: Rimuru and the Goblins' village is developing nicely. The Dwarves are building all kinds of houses and furniture, and the local Goblin Lords have appointed Rigurd as the Goblin King. As Rimuru watches everything come together, he decides to return to the cave and test the skills he received from Shizu. While there, he receives a request for help from Ranga through Thought Communication, and he rushes back to find his friends facing six Ogres. One of them orders Rimuru to "reveal his true identity." What is going on in the Great Forest of Jura?

episodes.title: The Orc Lord
episodes.overview: Six Ogres are all that remain of their clan after an attack by an Orc army. They say that the Orcs were traveling with a mysterious majin who wore plate mail and a clown mask. Rimuru proposes that the Ogres join his ranks, and they accept on the condition that they will get to take down the one leading the Orcs, so Rimuru gives all six of them names. Meanwhile, the Orcs begin to invade the marshlands surrounding Lake Siss that are inhabited by the Lizardmen. So the Lizardman chieftan gives his son, Gabiru, an order...

episodes.title: Gabiru is Here!
episodes.overview: Rimuru's village has gained Benimaru and the other five Ogres as its newest allies. Soon after, the Lizardman Gabiru visits the village, having heard rumors about it. Gabiru has been visiting Goblin villages throughout the Great Forest of Jura to enlist their aid in fighting off the Orc army. When he faces Ranga with an attitude of provocation, Ranga tells him that if he can defeat Gobta, they'll hear what he has to say...

episodes.title: The Gears Spin Out of Control
episodes.overview: The Orc army, led by the Orc Lord, continues its conquest throughout the Great Forest of Jura. The crisis has spurred Treyni of the Dryads, the caretakers of the forest, to take action. She has had her eye on Rimuru after noticing his rise to prominence in the forest, and she wants Rimuru to defeat the Orc Lord.

episodes.title: The Great Clash
episodes.overview: Rimuru and his Goblin riders set out for the marshlands to finalize their alliance with the Lizardmen. On the way, they save a Lizardman who'd been attacked by the Orcs. The victim turns out to be Gabiru's younger sister, who reveals that Gabiru led an insurrection and left to fight the Orc Lord without waiting for the alliance. She also pleads with Rimuru to save Gabiru and the rest of her clan. Meanwhile, Gabiru faces the massive Orc army and is shocked when he witnesses the power of their unique skill, Starved.

episodes.title: The One Who Devours All
episodes.overview: The majin Gelmud makes his appearance at last. His true goal was to evolve the Orc Lord into the Orc Disaster, a Demon Lord, and have him reign over the Forest of Jura. Upon learning this, the Orc Lord takes action...

episodes.title: The Jura Forest Alliance
episodes.overview: Post-war arrangements following the battle with the Orcs have begun. At the meeting, Rimuru reveals that he made a promise with the Orc Disaster, Geld, to take all of the Orcs' sins upon himself. When the Ogres and Lizardmen hear this...

episodes.title: Demon Lord Milim Attacks
episodes.overview: The Jura Tempest Federation, with Rimuru as its leader, has formed an alliance with the Armed Nation of Dwargon. Just as Rimuru thinks there are only peaceful days ahead, he senses an enormous mass of magical power heading straight for his location at an incredible speed. When the smoke from its collision with the ground clears, standing in its place is a humanoid figure. She is the Demon Mord Milim, the one and only Dragonoid and the one bearing the nickname "Destroyer." Ranga, Benimaru, and the others who face her are quickly overwhelmed by her power.

episodes.title: The Gathering
episodes.overview: The Demon Lord Carrion has sent one of his Three Beastketeers, Phobio, on a raid of Rimuru's city. However, Phobio is quickly defeated when Milim meets his attack with her own. Rimuru and his subordinates then ask Phobio why he has come to their town.

episodes.title: Evil Creeps Closer
episodes.overview: Phobio can't restrain his anger toward Milim. He finds himself faced with Footman and Tear, two masked members of the Moderate Harlequin Alliance, who suggest that he become a Demon Lord to take revenge on Milim. They tell him that he can accomplish this using the power of Charybdis. Meanwhile, the Jura Tempest Federation sends Youm out on a journey to make the world believe he was the champion who defeated the Orc Lord.

episodes.title: Charybdis
episodes.overview: Its seal removed, the calamity-class monster Charybdis and its Medalodon minions advance on the capital city of Rimuru. The Jura Tempest Federation combines all its forces under Rimuru to intercept the attack. King Gazel even sends 100 of his Pegasus Knights to aid in the battle. But Charybdis's extra skills Magic Jamming and Ultraspeed Regeneration make it a formidable foe. So Rimuru unleashes his new skill, Gluttony...

episodes.title: Yuuki Kagurazaka
episodes.overview: The threat of Charybdis has gone. That night, Rimuru has a dream in which he sees Shizu teaching children at her school in the Kingdom of Ingrassia—a dream showing Shizu's lingering regret. To see her wishes through, Rimuru leaves the Jura Tempest Federation and heads for the capital of the Kingdom of Ingrassia. His first goal is to meet with the Grandmaster of the Guild, Yuuki Kagurazaka, who happens to be a Summon and a former student of Shizu's.

episodes.title: Shizu-san's Students
episodes.overview: Rimuru becomes the new teacher for Shizu's students. However, having been summoned into this world against their will and facing shortened lifespans as a result, the children's feelings are complicated, and they're reluctant to accept Rimuru. So Rimuru proposes a series of mock battles with each of them to ascertain their abilities and allow them to let off steam.

episodes.title: Conquering the Labyrinth
episodes.overview: Rimuru tries to think of a way to save the children of Freedom Academy who are fated to die. The idea he comes up with is to have superior spirits inhabit each of them, as Shizu had, so their lives won't end prematurely. Determined to whatever it takes to save them, Rimuru leads the children to the Dwelling of Spirits, where superior spirits can be found. But as they make their way further inside, a Golem made of magisteel and controlled by the fairy Ramiris stands in their path.

episodes.title: Saved Souls
episodes.overview: Rimuru and the children reach the deepest level of the Dwelling of Spirits, where they stand on a pedestal bathed in light to summon superior spirits. Will their summoning be successful? Amidst the uncertainty, the first to attempt the summoning is Gale, followed by Alice, Kenya, Ryota, and finally Chloe. But instead of a spirit, Chloe's summoning brings forth an unknown spiritual form with an immense amount of energy. Just what is this spiritual being? Ramiris seems to sense something about it...

episodes.title: Black and the Mask
episodes.overview: This story takes place before Rimuru's reincarnation. Shizu, also known as the Conqueror of Flames, responds to an urgent request calling her to the Kingdom of Filtwood. When she reaches the castle, many adventurers are already there. What request could have demanded such a huge gathering? It turns out a demon has been revived, and the adventurers have been called to subjugate it. It is said that more than ten of the most skilled adventurers have already been killed by this demon. But there is more to this request than meets the eye...

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Now that the Jura Tempest Alliance is growing even further, they will now be meeting the animal kingdom of Eurazania, reuniting with King Gazel, rising tensions between monsters and humans, and Rimuru encountering the strongest enemy he’s ever faced.

episodes.title: Rimuru's Busy Life
episodes.overview: Rimuru sends a delegation led by Benimaru to the Animal Kingdom of Eurazania, ruled by the Demon Lord Carrion, also known as the Beastmaster, to establish diplomatic relations after becoming indebted to him in the battle against Charybdis. A delegation from Eurazania is set to arrive in Tempest around the same time, but the Animal Kingdom is a very warlike nation, and Shion is enraged when one of the delegates, Suphia of the Three Beastketeers, makes a belittling remark toward Rimuru. The goal was a friendly relationship, but it takes no time at all for a fight to break out...

episodes.title: Trade with the Animal Kingdom
episodes.overview: Despite the initial conflict, Eurazania and Tempest have deemed each other to be worthy of establishing friendly relations, and diplomacy between them officially begins. Tempest agrees to share its industrial techniques in return for Eurazania's agricultural techniques, and Rimuru decides to use the apple brandy produced as a result of this exchange to seek friendly relations with the Armed Nation of Dwargon next. He's accompanied by Shuna and Shion along with the former residents of Dwargon, Kaijin and the three Dwarf brothers, who are welcomed back to their home nation as state guests.

episodes.title: Paradise, Once More
episodes.overview: Rimuru completes the two very important duties of a discussion with King Dwargon and a public speech announcing the two nations' friendship to the people. Now it's time to head out for a little fun at the paradise he promised Gobta... while making sure Shuna and Shion don't notice.

episodes.title: The Scheming Kingdom of Falmuth
episodes.overview: Tempest is preparing a feast in celebration of Rimuru's return home. Then a newcomer, the majin Myulan, arrives to scope out Tempest on the Demon Lord Clayman's orders, having joined up with Youm's crew as their military advisor in order to enter the nation. Upon arriving, she's surprised to see what a strong nation it is, but continues to talk with its citizens to learn more. Meanwhile, the king of Falmuth, who sees Tempest as a nuisance, conspires with the Western Holy Church in a plot to invade the monster nation.

episodes.title: Prelude to the Disaster
episodes.overview: Following Clayman's orders, Myulan ignores the words of Youm and Grucius, both of whom have fallen in love with her, and activates the Anti-Magic Area spell. At the same time, Reyheim also activates Prison Field. The double barrier prevents Shion and the other fighters of Tempest from fighting as well as usual, and they end up at a disadvantage in their fights with three Otherworlders. Benimaru tries to contact Rimuru, who still hasn't returned, but he can't even get in touch with him due to the barriers.

episodes.title: The Beauty Makes Her Move
episodes.overview: At the same time as the attack on Tempest, Rimuru is also under attack. With one look, Rimuru realizes that his assailant is one of Shizu's former students, an Otherworlder, and the woman then introduces herself as the strongest of the Holy Knights, Hinata Sakaguchi. Rimuru is backed into a corner when her Holy Field seals most of his magic. At the same time, Shion and Hakurou, whose magic has been sealed by a similar barrier, are backed into a corner by Shogo and Kyoya.

episodes.title: Despair
episodes.overview: Rimuru faced grave danger in his battle with Hinata, but he managed to escape in the nick of time by using a doppelganger to take the damage while he rushed back to Tempest. Upon arrival, he found the city in a tragic state, engulfed by blood and smoke. Benimaru tries to capture Myulan, the top suspect behind this disaster, but Youm and Grucius stand in his way. Swallowing his rage and grief, Rimuru realizes who their true enemy is and calmly questions Myulan instead of punishing her.

episodes.title: Hope
episodes.overview: Rimuru learns about Clayman and the schemes of the Kingdom of Falmuth, but no matter how hard he wishes for it, his fallen comrades and their peaceful lifestyle will never return. He's just about to give up when Eren tells him of a fairy tale that might offer a glimmer of hope. The probability of success is about 3%... but if Rimuru can manage to become a Demon Lord by taking in the souls of 10,000 humans as nourishment, he just might have a chance at bringing his comrades back to life. As Falmuth's army of 20,000 men marches toward Tempest, Rimuru takes hold of that hope and decides to become a Demon Lord.

episodes.title: Putting Everything on the Line
episodes.overview: In order to come to terms with his own negligence and revive Shion, Gobta, and his other fallen comrades, Rimuru reveals that he used to be a human. But his allies think nothing of it and accept him regardless, as if it's the natural thing to do. Filled with gratitude for the warm, accepting environment he's in, Rimuru turns his focus to the army from Falmuth. He entrusts Benimaru and the others to destroy the devices that are generating the enemy's Prison Field while Rimuru himself sets out to attack the advancing army and use them as nourishment to become a Demon Lord.

episodes.title: Megiddo
episodes.overview: The battle for revenge has begun. Benimaru and his trusted companions carry out their respective missions, while Hakurou and his party face Shogo and Kyoya once again. And Rimuru's fury rains down upon the army from Falmuth.

episodes.title: Birth of a Demon Lord
episodes.overview: Rimuru succeeds in collecting enough souls to carry out his plan to evolve, and the Harvest Festival begins. But he's suddenly overcome by intense sleepiness at the same time, so he summons a demon to stop Razen, the one target who escaped alive. Then, upon returning to Tempest after successfully becoming a Demon Lord, Rimuru sets about attempting to revive Shion and the rest of the fallen. Through Raphael, the evolved form of Great Sage, the Secret Arts of Spirit Resurrection and Revival of the Dead are activated...

episodes.title: The One Unleashed
episodes.overview: Shion and the rest of the fallen are revived, Diablo has joined the team... It seems as if all is going smoothly, but Rimuru then receives a report that Milim has declared war and Eurazania has been destroyed, and there's still the matter of the Western Holy Church's hostility toward monsters, even with Falmuth out of the picture. But at the same time, Raphael informs him that the Appraisal of Unlimited Imprisonment has been completed. At last, two years after Rimuru's reincarnation into this world, he can finally fulfill the first promise he made here: to free Veldora.

episodes.title: The Visitors
episodes.overview: A feast is thrown to celebrate the revival of Tempest's fallen and the return of Veldora. After enjoying a brief, peaceful respite, Rimuru tells everyone his future plans: he's going to get the word out to the whole world that he's a Demon Lord and declare war against Clayman. Then King Gazel of the Armed Nation of Dwargon, Fuze of the Kingdom of Blumund, and Eren's father, Archduke Elalude of the Sorcerous Dynasty of Thalion, all arrive in Tempest, and an important meeting to discuss the nation's future begins.

episodes.title: A Meeting of Humans and Monsters
episodes.overview: As prominent figures from several nations assemble in Tempest for a meeting, Laplace and his companions formulate a plan centered around Clayman. Then someone familiar joins the discussion...

episodes.title: Ramiris's Warning
episodes.overview: Rimuru announces his plan to back Youm as the new king of Falmuth. After hearing this, Gazel tests Youm to see if he has what it takes to be a ruler, and Youm answers with full sincerity. Erald also takes a liking to Rimuru after hearing him say he just wants to create a world where everyone can prosper and smile. Thus Rimuru and his allies look ahead to the battle against their new enemy, Clayman.

episodes.title: The Congress Dances
episodes.overview: A new force has suddenly risen to power in the Great Forest of Jura, and its leader, Clayman, proposes that the Demon Lords hold Walpurgis with the goal of sanctioning the slime who deceived him. Rimuru also begins to prepare for a battle with Clayman, but observing the enemy army's movements reveals that Clayman's target is not Tempest, but Eurazania. Clayman's army will arrive in Eurazania within two days. Can Rimuru's forces get there in time?

episodes.title: The Eve of Battle
episodes.overview: To put a stop to Clayman's plans, Rimuru uses transport magic on a large scale to both move Tempest's army to Eurazania and evacuate the people of Eurazania to Tempest. Rimuru also decides to crash Walpurgis, the Demon Lords' banquet, in order to settle the score with Clayman personally. Since this will be a return match for Shion, he decides to take her and Ranga along. New military forces are organized in Tempest in preparation for the battle against Clayman's army. At last, the eve of battle is upon them...

episodes.title: The Demon Lords
episodes.overview: Benimaru leads his army to Eurazania, and Youm heads to Falmuth to take it over along with his buddies and Diablo. Rimuru succeeds in outwitting Clayman by transporting all of Eurazania's refugees to Tempest. Since Clayman has been striving to evolve into an Awakened Demon Lord for a long time, his resentment toward Rimuru grows. Meanwhile, Demon Lord Leon, Veldora's sister Velzard, and Guy, the oldest of the Demon Lords, become increasingly impressed with Rimuru.

episodes.title: The Signal to Begin the Banquet
episodes.overview: Rimuru continues with preparations for Walpurgis, including making Treyni evolve into a Dryas Doll Dryad. Meanwhile, Benimaru and his forces have arrived in Eurazania via transport magic, and they promptly run Clayman's army into a trap set by Geld. The Three Beastketeers, determined to rescue Carrion, set out to subdue the enemy army's leader. Albis fights one-on-one with Yamza of the Five Fingers, while Phobio takes on Footman and Tear.

episodes.title: On This Land Where It All Happened
episodes.overview: Gabiru narrowly wins his battle against Hermes. Watching their outcome is Middray of the Dragon Faithful, whose skill was enough to overwhelm even Suphia. Though he looks like a human, he is actually a Dragonewt like Gabiru. Meanwhile, Yamza uses his artifact Doppelganger to create a double of himself, but Albis still defeats him soundly. He tries to surrender, but Clayman takes control of him and forces him to transform into Charybdis.

episodes.title: Adalman, the Index Finger
episodes.overview: With all the preparations complete, Rimuru heads out to attend Walpurgis with Shion and Ranga, while Ramiris takes Beretta and Treyni. In the meantime, Shuna, Hakuro, and Soei find both their vision and their magic detection abilities hindered by a thick fog as they draw closer to Clayman's castle. From within the fog appears the Index Finger of Clayman's Five Fingers, Adalman, also known as the White King. Hakuro and Soei hold the enemies around them at bay while Shuna faces Adalman one-on-one.

episodes.title: Demon Lords' Banquet ~Walpurgis~
episodes.overview: Clayman tries to convince the other Demon Lords that Rimuru should be purged, but Guy tells him that if he is truly a Demon Lord, he should defeat Rimuru himself. What should be a one-on-one battle between Rimuru and Clayman is joined by Milim, who has been brainwashed by Clayman, so Rimuru takes on Milim while Shion faces Clayman. But Rimuru is at a disadvantage against Milim and finds himself pushed back... until Veldora bursts onto the scene and takes Milim's attack in Rimuru's place.

episodes.title: Returning from the Brink
episodes.overview: Clayman and his pawns stand no chance against Rimuru and his allies. At a loss, Clayman orders Milim to use Stampede to kill everyone present, but Milim reveals he was never controlling her from the start. It was all an act to expose Clayman's plans and identify the mastermind behind it all. Even Carrion is still alive and well. On the brink of death, Clayman uses the souls of everyone he has killed as energy for his awakening. Thus the final battle to settle the score between Rimuru and Clayman begins.

episodes.title: Octagram
episodes.overview: Rimuru backs Clayman into a corner trying to get him to reveal who he's working for, but even on death's door, Clayman's lips are sealed. Left with no other choice, Rimuru finishes Clayman off. With Clayman dead and Carrion and Frey announcing that they're stepping down as Demon Lords, the total number of Demon Lords including Rimuru is reduced from ten to eight. Guy coerces Rimuru into coming up with a new name for their group, and Rimuru's solution is "Octagram," representing each of the Demon Lords as an eight-pointed star. Thus a slime became one of the eight Demon Lords, marking the start of a new age.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: After Clayman’s defeat, Rimuru returns home and learns that Diablo healed the nobles of Falmuth, securing their alliance with Tempest. Meanwhile, Hinata becomes suspicious of Rimuru’s growing power and confronts him—unaware that a powerful organization is pulling the strings behind the scenes.

episodes.title: Demons and Strategies
episodes.overview: Rimuru has returned to Jura after having attended Walpurgis. Diablo informs Rimuru of his mission to deal with the Kingdom of Falmuth. Having presented the kingdom with three options at a resolution, the clock on the week for their answer ticks down.

episodes.title: The Saint's Intentions
episodes.overview: Yuuki is saddened by the death of Clayman, and Luminus is saddened by the death of Roy. Steeped in sadness, and having lost their friends, they seek their next move against Rimuru, who has grown in power and become a true Demon Lord.

episodes.title: Peaceful Days
episodes.overview: Expecting visitors from all races to come calling after learning that Rimuru now controls the entire Great Forest of Jura, Rimuru decides to hold a festival to introduce himself and Tempest to the world, with the goal of attracting new citizens.

episodes.title: Everyone Has a Part to Play
episodes.overview: Responding to Rimuru's concerns about monsters in the forest harming humans, Vesta and Kaijin reveal a new invention they hope will keep the road to Tempest safe. Also, Rimuru assigns a new task to Geld.

episodes.title: Meeting of Both Sides
episodes.overview: A war council led by Hinata is held in the Holy Empire of Lubelius. Moments after Hinata declares her intent to meet Rimuru and talk to him, she receives a hostile message from Rimuru.

episodes.title: Those Approaching
episodes.overview: The spread of false information causes the Temple Knights to assemble, endangering Diablo's plan to conquer Falmuth. Meanwhile, Rimuru learns that Hinata is on her way to Tempest.

episodes.title: Saint and Demon Clash
episodes.overview: As Hinata makes her way to Tempest, the ramen and well-built roads she sees along the way prove to her that Rimuru genuinely wants monsters and humans to coexist. But against her wishes, one of her men is also on his way to Tempest...

episodes.title: Misunderstanding
episodes.overview: The Crusaders have reached Tempest, and the battle is on. Hinata lays everything she learned from her mentor, Shizu, on the line in a life-or-death showdown against Rimuru.

episodes.title: The Scheming of the Seven Days
episodes.overview: Diablo descends before the enemy, King Edward of Falmuth. Also present are Saare and Glenda, two of the three Battlesages who are regarded as the most brilliant among the Master Rooks.

episodes.title: God and Demon Lord
episodes.overview: Just after the end of Hinata and Rimuru's duel, Hinata's sword moves on its own and targets Rimuru. Hinata jumps in its way to protect him and is gravely injured. Then the masterminds behind the whole conflict show up...

episodes.title: Reconciliation and Agreement
episodes.overview: The Seven Days Clergy have been purged, and the battle is over. Rimuru and Hinata hold a meeting to discuss future relations between their two nations, and the masterminds behind the whole conflict, the Eastern merchants, are revealed.

episodes.title: Festival Preparations
episodes.overview: Everyone in Tempest is busy preparing for the festival to celebrate the country's opening. Rimuru visits Mjöllmile to share ideas on forms of entertainment that will keep people coming back for more.

episodes.title: Invitation for All Nations
episodes.overview: Demon Lord Ramiris tries to argue her way into moving to Tempest, where there's great food, hot springs, and ample entertainment. Rimuru happens to walk into the argument and comes up with a way to make use of Ramiris's skills.

episodes.title: Labyrinth and Storm Dragon
episodes.overview: Rimuru is building a dungeon in preparation for the upcoming festival. It will feature treasure chests containing weapons made by Kurobe, and Veldora will inhabit the deepest floor as the final boss. Then Milim suddenly shows up with a suggestion...

episodes.title: Audience
episodes.overview: Numerous representatives from across the Great Forest of Jura have assembled in Tempest to congratulate Rimuru on his appointment to Demon Lord. Shuna requests holding a three-day audience to meet with them.

episodes.title: Benimaru's Ordeal
episodes.overview: On the last day of the audience, Rimuru meets Momiji, the representative of the Tengu clan. Their meeting comes after Rimuru had sent Benimaru to the Tengu village to request their permission to build a tunnel through the Kusha Mountains.

episodes.title: The Lightspeed Hero
episodes.overview: After learning about an elf slave trade, Rimuru had Soei investigate, but it turns out the slave traders have already been shut down by Masayuki, the Lightspeed Hero. Word is now spreading that the Hero is headed to Tempest to slay a Demon Lord...

episodes.title: A Throng of Visitors
episodes.overview: After meeting with the kings of various nations, Rimuru heads to Engrassia to invite his former students to the festival. The kids are thrilled to go back with him to Tempest, but then the hero Masayuki arrives as well...

episodes.title: Festival Eve
episodes.overview: The night before the Opening Festival, Rimuru throws a lavish banquet for all the nobles and royalty visiting Tempest. When the party is in full swing, Empress Elmesia of the Sorcerous Dynasty of Thalion arrives, throwing everyone into chaos.

episodes.title: Nation's Opening Festival
episodes.overview: It's day one of the festival, and Rimuru finally gets to see all of his friends' performances and presentations. As he's enojying the festivities, he's summoned by Luminus...

episodes.title: The Martial Arts Tournament
episodes.overview: A martial arts tournament is being held! The winner will be given the right to challenge Rimuru. The hero, Masayuki, will be participating in the tournament. Rimuru wants to uncover the hero's true strength, so they get Geld and Gobta to participate.

episodes.title: Settling the Score with the Hero
episodes.overview: Gazel and Elmesia pledge to assist Rimuru with Tempest's lack of funding. Elmesia then proposes an alliance, but she's concerned about the danger Diablo poses.

episodes.title: The Labyrinth Is Opened
episodes.overview: Rimuru's dungeon is finally revealed, and his new ally Masayuki is among its first challengers. Later, after the festival is over, Rimuru's biggest job still awaits.

episodes.title: After the Festival
episodes.overview: Rimuru pays the merchants with the gold coins he's procured. The merchants try to garner futher favor, but Rimuru ceases trading with them. Rimuru then gathers his allies and calls for action again the eastern merchants who are operating in secret.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Demon Lord Rimuru's dream of creating an alliance between humans and monsters takes a step closer to being realized. As Tempest continues to prosper, Granville Rozzo and his granddaughter, Maribel Rozzo, clash with Demon Lord Rimuru over their plan to protect mankind by ruling over them. Meanwhile, in El Dorado, Demon Lord Leon works toward goals of his own. The awakening of a new Hero draws near!

episodes.title: New Days
episodes.overview: Tempest is thriving after the success of its festival, but unexpected trouble has arisen with the new dungeon.

episodes.title: The Dungeon Evolves
episodes.overview: Rimuru and his trusted companions discuss ideas for improving the dungeon.

episodes.title: The Avatar Team Is Formed
episodes.overview: Rimuru, Ramiris, Veldora, and Milim work on perfecting their avatars before facing Team Green Fury.

episodes.title: Invitation
episodes.overview: The Council of the West deliberates on whether to grant membership to Tempest.

episodes.title: The First Step
episodes.overview: Rimuru attends the meeting that will determine Tempest's membership in the Council of the West.

episodes.title: The Council of the West
episodes.overview: A list of unreasonable demands from the Council makes Rimuru realize that a deeper plot is in motion.

episodes.title: The Mastermind's Identity
episodes.overview: An interrogation of Prince Elric's would-be shooter reveals who's pulling the strings behind the Council.

episodes.title: The Groundwork of Greed
episodes.overview: Glenda reveals all she knows about the Council and the Rozzos, and Rimuru prepares to inspect ancient ruins.

episodes.title: Investigating the Ruins
episodes.overview: The investigation of the ancient ruins of Amrita begins.

episodes.title: The Master of Greed
episodes.overview: Rimuru and Mirabel come face-to-face at last in the ancient ruins.

episodes.title: Milim's Friend
episodes.overview: Rimuru helps Milim confront the Chaos Dragon, a corrupted form of the baby dragon that was once her friend.

episodes.title: Tempest Evolves
episodes.overview: Rimuru shares his plans for Tempest's future, including a new system of government and Council representation.

episodes.title: New Companions
episodes.overview: Ramiris and Veldora are feeling overworked, so they ask Rimuru to find assistants for them.

episodes.title: The Black Numbers
episodes.overview: Diablo returns with new demon subordinates to add to Tempest's ranks.

episodes.title: An Unsettling Feeling
episodes.overview: As Tempest continues to grow and evolve, the Moderate Harlequin Alliance approaches Demon Lord Leon.

episodes.title: Gran, the Hero of Dawn
episodes.overview: Luminus meets with Rimuru to discuss Gran and future plans.

episodes.title: Lubelius, the Point of Convergence
episodes.overview: While Leon seeks Elmesia's help in finding Chloe, Granville's forces invade Lubelius.

episodes.title: Turbulence in the West
episodes.overview: An army of demons advances from the north, leaving the Western Nations in turmoil.

episodes.title: Death and Loss
episodes.overview: Granville's true plan is revealed, but it may already be too late to stop it.

episodes.title: Chronoa the Hero (1)
episodes.overview: When Chloe's Time Traveler skill kicks in, Hinata's soul is sent to the past along with her.

episodes.title: Chronoa the Hero (2)
episodes.overview: Chloe and Hinata meet Luminus and begin their journey as Chronoa.

episodes.title: The Storm Dragon, Veldora
episodes.overview: Mikami Satoru, a businessman, is stabbed by a criminal on the street and killed. When he regains consciousness in the darkness, he finds that he's been reincarnated as a slime! With nothing better to do, he spends his time devouring all the rare herbs and precious ores he comes across. As he does, he encounters the Storm Dragon Veldora, who was sealed in this cave 300 years ago by a hero's "Unlimited Imprisonment" skill. He's frightened at first, but as they talk, he becomes friends with the long-isolated Veldora.

episodes.title: Meeting the Goblins
episodes.overview: The slime Mikami and the Storm Dragon Veldora decide to give each other names. Veldora gives the slime Mikami the name "Rimuru," and Rimuru comes up with a family name for both of them: "Tempest." Then Rimuru uses his Predator skill to take Veldora into his body and analyze the "Unlimited Imprisonment" seal in hopes of breaking it... but this action sends a shock through the nations surrounding the Great Forest of Jura. With Veldora gone, there's a chance that the larger nations could become bold and invade the smaller provinces. With no knowledge of this, Rimuru leaves the cave and meets some Goblins.

episodes.title: Battle at the Goblin Village
episodes.overview: After leaving the cave, Rimuru encounters a village of Goblins under attack by a clan of Direwolves. Caught in the heat of the moment, Rimuru agrees to help the Goblins in their battle. That night, the Direwolves arrive to try to take over as the new rulers of the Great Forest of Jura!

episodes.title: In the Kingdom of the Dwarves
episodes.overview: Rimuru and his companions visit the Dwarven Kingdom, the Armed Nation of Dwargon, in search of some artisans to help the Goblins learn to supply their own food, shelter, and clothing. However, a skirmish just outside the city gate lands Rimuru and Gobta in a prison cell. Then there's a report of an Armorsaurus in the nearby mines!

episodes.title: Hero King, Gazel Dwargo
episodes.overview: Thanks to Rimuru's skill, Kaijin was able to finish all the longswords and deliver them to the king, so the two of them celebrate by heading to a bar staffed by lots of elf girls. One of them reads Rimuru's fortune for fun, and sees an image in her crystal ball of someone she believes Rimuru is destined to be with. As everyone wonders who this person could be, Vesta shows up and starts to hassle Rimuru...

episodes.title: Shizu
episodes.overview: One day, in the midst of the improvements on the Goblin Village with the help of Kaijin and the dwarves, Rimuru meets a trio of adventurers from the Guild who've been temporarily joined by a masked woman named Shizu. Shizu turns out to be the person Rimuru is destined to be with, as his fortune said. Shizu also came to this world from Japan, but unlike him, she was summoned here many years ago. So Rimuru uses his Thought Communication skill to show Shizu what Japan looks like today.

episodes.title: Conqueror of Flames
episodes.overview: The Demon Lord Leon Cromwell summoned Shizu out of Tokyo as it burned during in the air raids, then forced the high-ranked spirit Ifrit to possess her. After taking over Shizu's body, Ifrit begins to rampage.

episodes.title: Inherited Will
episodes.overview: When Shizu was still with Demon Lord Leon, it was a Hero who rescued her. That Hero was Shizu's inspiration to help as many people as she could for many years. She even worked as a teacher for children who'd come from other worlds. And now, as her time comes to an end, Shizu asks Rimuru for one last favor...

episodes.title: Attack of the Ogres
episodes.overview: Rimuru and the Goblins' village is developing nicely. The Dwarves are building all kinds of houses and furniture, and the local Goblin Lords have appointed Rigurd as the Goblin King. As Rimuru watches everything come together, he decides to return to the cave and test the skills he received from Shizu. While there, he receives a request for help from Ranga through Thought Communication, and he rushes back to find his friends facing six Ogres. One of them orders Rimuru to "reveal his true identity." What is going on in the Great Forest of Jura?

episodes.title: The Orc Lord
episodes.overview: Six Ogres are all that remain of their clan after an attack by an Orc army. They say that the Orcs were traveling with a mysterious majin who wore plate mail and a clown mask. Rimuru proposes that the Ogres join his ranks, and they accept on the condition that they will get to take down the one leading the Orcs, so Rimuru gives all six of them names. Meanwhile, the Orcs begin to invade the marshlands surrounding Lake Siss that are inhabited by the Lizardmen. So the Lizardman chieftan gives his son, Gabiru, an order...

episodes.title: Gabiru is Here!
episodes.overview: Rimuru's village has gained Benimaru and the other five Ogres as its newest allies. Soon after, the Lizardman Gabiru visits the village, having heard rumors about it. Gabiru has been visiting Goblin villages throughout the Great Forest of Jura to enlist their aid in fighting off the Orc army. When he faces Ranga with an attitude of provocation, Ranga tells him that if he can defeat Gobta, they'll hear what he has to say...

episodes.title: The Gears Spin Out of Control
episodes.overview: The Orc army, led by the Orc Lord, continues its conquest throughout the Great Forest of Jura. The crisis has spurred Treyni of the Dryads, the caretakers of the forest, to take action. She has had her eye on Rimuru after noticing his rise to prominence in the forest, and she wants Rimuru to defeat the Orc Lord.

episodes.title: The Great Clash
episodes.overview: Rimuru and his Goblin riders set out for the marshlands to finalize their alliance with the Lizardmen. On the way, they save a Lizardman who'd been attacked by the Orcs. The victim turns out to be Gabiru's younger sister, who reveals that Gabiru led an insurrection and left to fight the Orc Lord without waiting for the alliance. She also pleads with Rimuru to save Gabiru and the rest of her clan. Meanwhile, Gabiru faces the massive Orc army and is shocked when he witnesses the power of their unique skill, Starved.

episodes.title: The One Who Devours All
episodes.overview: The majin Gelmud makes his appearance at last. His true goal was to evolve the Orc Lord into the Orc Disaster, a Demon Lord, and have him reign over the Forest of Jura. Upon learning this, the Orc Lord takes action...

episodes.title: The Jura Forest Alliance
episodes.overview: Post-war arrangements following the battle with the Orcs have begun. At the meeting, Rimuru reveals that he made a promise with the Orc Disaster, Geld, to take all of the Orcs' sins upon himself. When the Ogres and Lizardmen hear this...

episodes.title: Demon Lord Milim Attacks
episodes.overview: The Jura Tempest Federation, with Rimuru as its leader, has formed an alliance with the Armed Nation of Dwargon. Just as Rimuru thinks there are only peaceful days ahead, he senses an enormous mass of magical power heading straight for his location at an incredible speed. When the smoke from its collision with the ground clears, standing in its place is a humanoid figure. She is the Demon Mord Milim, the one and only Dragonoid and the one bearing the nickname "Destroyer." Ranga, Benimaru, and the others who face her are quickly overwhelmed by her power.

episodes.title: The Gathering
episodes.overview: The Demon Lord Carrion has sent one of his Three Beastketeers, Phobio, on a raid of Rimuru's city. However, Phobio is quickly defeated when Milim meets his attack with her own. Rimuru and his subordinates then ask Phobio why he has come to their town.

episodes.title: Evil Creeps Closer
episodes.overview: Phobio can't restrain his anger toward Milim. He finds himself faced with Footman and Tear, two masked members of the Moderate Harlequin Alliance, who suggest that he become a Demon Lord to take revenge on Milim. They tell him that he can accomplish this using the power of Charybdis. Meanwhile, the Jura Tempest Federation sends Youm out on a journey to make the world believe he was the champion who defeated the Orc Lord.

episodes.title: Charybdis
episodes.overview: Its seal removed, the calamity-class monster Charybdis and its Medalodon minions advance on the capital city of Rimuru. The Jura Tempest Federation combines all its forces under Rimuru to intercept the attack. King Gazel even sends 100 of his Pegasus Knights to aid in the battle. But Charybdis's extra skills Magic Jamming and Ultraspeed Regeneration make it a formidable foe. So Rimuru unleashes his new skill, Gluttony...

episodes.title: Yuuki Kagurazaka
episodes.overview: The threat of Charybdis has gone. That night, Rimuru has a dream in which he sees Shizu teaching children at her school in the Kingdom of Ingrassia—a dream showing Shizu's lingering regret. To see her wishes through, Rimuru leaves the Jura Tempest Federation and heads for the capital of the Kingdom of Ingrassia. His first goal is to meet with the Grandmaster of the Guild, Yuuki Kagurazaka, who happens to be a Summon and a former student of Shizu's.

episodes.title: Shizu-san's Students
episodes.overview: Rimuru becomes the new teacher for Shizu's students. However, having been summoned into this world against their will and facing shortened lifespans as a result, the children's feelings are complicated, and they're reluctant to accept Rimuru. So Rimuru proposes a series of mock battles with each of them to ascertain their abilities and allow them to let off steam.

episodes.title: Conquering the Labyrinth
episodes.overview: Rimuru tries to think of a way to save the children of Freedom Academy who are fated to die. The idea he comes up with is to have superior spirits inhabit each of them, as Shizu had, so their lives won't end prematurely. Determined to whatever it takes to save them, Rimuru leads the children to the Dwelling of Spirits, where superior spirits can be found. But as they make their way further inside, a Golem made of magisteel and controlled by the fairy Ramiris stands in their path.

episodes.title: Saved Souls
episodes.overview: Rimuru and the children reach the deepest level of the Dwelling of Spirits, where they stand on a pedestal bathed in light to summon superior spirits. Will their summoning be successful? Amidst the uncertainty, the first to attempt the summoning is Gale, followed by Alice, Kenya, Ryota, and finally Chloe. But instead of a spirit, Chloe's summoning brings forth an unknown spiritual form with an immense amount of energy. Just what is this spiritual being? Ramiris seems to sense something about it...

episodes.title: Black and the Mask
episodes.overview: This story takes place before Rimuru's reincarnation. Shizu, also known as the Conqueror of Flames, responds to an urgent request calling her to the Kingdom of Filtwood. When she reaches the castle, many adventurers are already there. What request could have demanded such a huge gathering? It turns out a demon has been revived, and the adventurers have been called to subjugate it. It is said that more than ten of the most skilled adventurers have already been killed by this demon. But there is more to this request than meets the eye...

items.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation
items.overview: When a 34-year-old underachiever gets run over by a truck, his story doesn't end there. Reincarnated in a new world as an infant, Rudy will seize every opportunity to live the life he's always wanted. Armed with new friends, some freshly acquired magical abilities, and the courage to do the things he's always dreamed of, he's embarking on an epic adventure—with all of his past experience intact!
